BTip1: Press '&m_next_target*' to target an enemy when the red target marker is in view.
BTip2: Press '&start_team_chat*' to chat with your team.
BTip3: Press '&toggle_Weapon_Group*' to assign a weapon to a group. Use the Arrow Keys to change selected weapon or group. (Default Keys)
BTip4: '&attack1*' is mapped to fire the currently selected weapons group. Be mindful of which group you have selected when you finish editing your setup.
BTip5: Mastering control of your 'Mech is challenging at first. Every MechWarrior must learn to control their torso and legs separately in order to succeed.
BTip6: Press'&show_scoreboard*' to see the current scores and other useful information.
BTip9: Think of your 'Mech as a walking tank. You must control the torso independently from the legs.
BTip11: Press '&m_torso_center*' to center your torso to the direction of your legs
BTip12: Press '&m_jump_jet*' to use your jump jets.
BTip13: MC means MechWarrior Credits. Use them to purchase Hero 'Mechs, 'Mech Bays, Premium Time, and more.
BTip14: The Cadet bonus awards extra C-Bills and is awarded to new recruits and lasts for your first 25 games.
BTip15: Long Range Missiles (LRMs) are able to strike distant targets that are beyond line-of-sight with the help of friendly target locks.
BTip16: Your match earnings are based on your performance. Be a valuable asset to your team to reap the highest rewards.
BTip17: A 'Mech shielded by an allied ECM cannot be targeted by any other 'Mech standing more than 120m away.
BTip18: Hero 'Mechs are variants with unique patterns, hardpoints, and a 30% C-Bills bonus. Hero 'Mechs can be bought with MC in the Store.
BTip19: Premium Time grants a 50% bonus to both XP and C-Bills. Premium time can be bought with MC in the Store.
BTip20: Not sure which 'Mech is best for you? Trial 'Mechs are free and change regularly.
BTip21: A 'Mech cannot survive without both legs, the center torso, or its head. Inner Sphere 'Mechs equipped with an XL engine will also die if either side torso is destroyed.
BTip22: All weapons generate heat when fired.  When a 'Mech is too hot, it will automatically shut down while the 'Mech cools off.  A shutdown 'Mech is incredibly vulnerable and will take damage if shut down for too long.
BTip23: If you are targeted by incoming missiles, be sure to take cover. Hide behind terrain or buildings as fast as you can.
BTip24: Working as a team increases your chance of survival overwhelmingly.
BTip25: Remember that your legs and torso can face in different directions. Use the mini-map arrow to orient your movement in relation to your torso's field of view. You can press '&m_torso_centre*' to re-center your view.
BTip26: Be careful when using jump jets. Falling long distances can cause damage.
BTip27: If you find that you're overheating in battle, consider adding more heat sinks, upgrading to double heat sinks or slowing your rate of fire.
BTip28: Be aware of your allies as much as the enemy. Your weapons can hurt your allies too.
BTip30: Trial 'Mech loadouts and camouflage cannot be changed until the 'Mech has been purchased.
BTip31: You can customize, tweak and improve your owned 'Mechs in the Mech Lab.
BTip32: If you want to fly high - equip more jump jets.
BTip33: Add people you enjoy playing with to your friends list.
BTip34: For the latest news and forum discussions, head over to www.mwomercs.com.
BTip36: Need to improve? Visit the MechWarrior Academy from the Home Screen.
BTip37: Running out of room? Mech Bay slots allow you to purchase and store more 'Mechs.
BTip38: Convert XP to GXP to unlock efficiencies across other 'Mech chassis variants.
BTip39: Press '&start_chat*' to chat with all pilots on the battlefield.
BTip40: Pilots can participate in the war between the Great Houses of the Inner Sphere and the Invading Clans via the Faction Play button.
BTip41: Pressing '&thirdpersoncombatcam*' allows you to engage and disengage the 3rd person view drone.
BTip42: '&thirdpersoncombatcam*' allows you to switch between 1st and 3rd person views.
ITip1: Press '&show_battlegrid*' to see the Battlegrid.  From here, the commander can issue orders to the team.  Take command yourself if you're up for the challenge.
ITip2: If you want to disappear from the enemy's radar - press ^powerToggle* to power down.
ITip3: Press '&m_show_target_overlay*' to see all available information of `Mechs in the battlefield.
ITip4: Press and Hold '&m_freelook*' to look around the cockpit
ITip5: Press '&m_toggle_zoom_mode*' to zoom in to provide improved precision for long range weapons.
ITip6: Can't see a thing at night? Press '&m_toggle_night_vision*' for night vision or '&m_toggle_thermal_vision*' for thermal vision.
ITip7: You can press '&m_toggle_ecm_mode*' on your keyboard to switch your ECM into Counter-mode.
ITip8: 'Mechs and items can be sold from your inventory for C-Bills.  Be careful, this is irreversible.
ITip9: Many cockpit items are seasonally available.  Watch out for new items.
ITip10: Customize the look of your owned 'Mechs in the Camo Spec section of the Mech Lab.
ITip11: A hollow triangle represents a 'Mech that is not targeted by any teammates.  A filled triangle means someone is targeting that 'Mech.  Target 'Mechs that are already targeted by your team.
ITip12: Arm mounted weapons typically have greater range of motion than those mounted on a 'Mech's torso.
ITip13: The % health is a total of all parts that make up a 'Mech.  Each component of a 'Mech has its own health and may be critical to the survival of that 'Mech.
ITip14: Faster 'Mechs are great against slower opponents. Get behind larger prey to rip through their rear armor.
ITip15: A 'legged' 'Mech can only move at 50% normal speed or 40 km/h, which ever is slower.
ITip16: Your 'Mech is locked once it has been launched.  It can only be reused once that mission is over.
ITip17: Be sure to check for your target's weak points, they may already be close to their demise.
ITip18: Running into your teammates or enemies will result in damage to both you and the other 'Mech.
ITip19: Inner Sphere Long Range Missiles (LRM) have a minimum arming range.  When fired at a target within that range, they will do 0 damage. The Clans do not have this disadvantage.
ITip20: Short Range Missiles arm immediately when fired.
ITip21: Range indicated for LRM's indicates the maximum travel distance of each missile.  Take into account the likely trajectory when firing at a target close to maximum range.
ITip22: Heat sinks in the legs are more effective when submerged in water.
ITip23: Ambient temperature affects the effectiveness of all heat sinks on your 'Mech.
ITip24: Weapons, ammo and equipped items are destroyed independently.  However, a destroyed arm will lose all heat sinks, ammo, weapons and other items contained within.
ITip25: Continued, sustained damage will transfer from a destroyed location to the next adjacent part.
ITip26: Accepting a Call to Arms pop-up is a sure way to get into a Faction match.
ITip27: The Artemis IV Fire Control System improves the accuracy of your missiles
ITip28: A 'Mech affected by an enemy ECM is unable to share information with teammates.
ITip29: The TAG laser can be used to make an ECM shielded enemy targetable if it's used from outside the 120m cover range of the ECM.
ITip30: An allied ECM in Counter-mode will disable the nearest enemy ECM in Disrupt-mode.
ITip31: For the TAG laser to be effective, it must constantly remain on the target.
ITip32: Enemy 'Mechs affected by a NARC will cause allies to acquire missile locks 75% faster.
ITip33: Locked-on missiles fired at a target affected by a Narc will receive a 100% increase to their tracking strength.
ITip34: Most Clan 'Mechs use customizable components called OmniPods that allow them to mix and match parts from different variants of the same chassis.
ITip35: XL engines allow for tremendous speeds and lower weight, but at the cost of increased vulnerability and slots used in both side torsos.
ITip36: Armor on the torso and side torso is shared between the front and the back.  Choose for your situation and playstyle where you need the most.
ITip37: While Clan weapons generally hold a range advantage over their Inner Sphere counterparts they often take longer to deal the same amount of damage.
ITip38: Use XP earned in the Skills tab to unlock Skills in your owned 'Mechs.
ITip39: Only some 'Mech variants can equip an ECM.
ITip40: Each 'Mech has a maximum weight it can carry.  Be sure to balance your 'Mech as effectively as possible between your needs for ammunition, weaponry, heat management, armor and support items.
ITip41: Don’t forget to equip appropriate ammo when mounting a new weapon that requires it.
ITip42: LRM - Long Range Missile.  SRM - Short Range Missile.  SSRM - Streak Short Range Missile.
ITip44: Some Clan weapons have different firing patterns than their Inner Sphere counterparts.
ATip1: Using chainfire '&m_toggleChainfireGroup*' can help manage heat generated over time.
ATip2: Press '&ToggleInfoVis*' to see health and names of your teammates when you have your battlegrid open
ATip3: Press '&shutdownOverride*' to override the heat shutdown. The BattleMech manufacturer, 'Mech Bay engineers and House Military Operations are not responsible for damage sustained from excessive heat whilst override shutdown is engaged.
ATip4: Weapon ranges indicated show the maximum distance for optimal damage. Damage can be dealt beyond that range for some weapons, but at a reduced rate.
ATip5: The Anti-Missile System (AMS) will destroy missiles passing within 120m of your 'Mech, prioritizing those targeted on you.
ATip6: There is no force in the galaxy able to withstand a well-coordinated unit; their services are sought by powerful factions across the Inner Sphere.
ATip7: Where your armor is destroyed, your weapons and equipped items are vulnerable to critical hits.
ATip8: Gauss rifles are more likely to be critted than other weapon types and will explode when destroyed.
ATip9: Unlike other ammo types, Gauss ammo does not explode.
ATip10: Advances in Clan combat computing allow their 'Mechs to be outfitted with targeting computers that enhance sensor range, information gathering and projectile speed.
ATip11: NARCs attached to 'Mechs shielded by an allied ECM cannot broadcast but remain active.
ATip12: Being protected by an ECM prevents an enemy Beagle Active Probe from providing bonuses.
ATip13: Shooting an enemy 'Mech with a Tag will cause allies to acquire missile locks 50% faster and allied locked-on missiles to receive a 50% bonus on their tracking strength.
ATip14: Multiple Tag lasers do not stack bonuses together.
ATip15: Narc and Tag stack together for bigger bonuses.
ATip16: The Beagle Active Probe increases sensor range, speeds up targeting data, counters ECM, and can detect shut down 'Mechs at close range.
ATip17: The Beagle Active Probe allows you to detect powered down 'Mechs if they are within 120m of you.
ATip18: The Beagle Active Probe allows you to receive information about enemy 'Mechs 25% faster.
ATip19: Clan armor and heat sinks occupy less space than Inner Sphere counterparts but their 'Mechs often have fixed equipment like jump jets that cannot be removed.
ATip20: Despite the threat posed by the Clans, the Great Houses still fight amongst themselves, often to the detriment of their effort against the invaders.
ATip21: Consumables can provide big advantages when used at the right moment. You don't lose Consumables when they're deployed in the Testing Grounds, so take them for a test run to familiarize yourself with how they work.
ATip22: Use the Skill Tree to increase the potency of your weapons, boost your survivability, improve your operational efficiency and mobility, upgrade your sensory systems, and more.
ATip23: Units credited with winning the majority of matches during a successful invasion will have their unit's tag bestowed upon the conquered world for all to see.
ATip24: Endo-steel and Ferro Fibrous armor are two ways to free up additional weight for more flexibility in the 'Mech loadout. Each comes at a cost of 14 internal slots.
ATip25: 'Mech XP (XP) earned from matches is assigned to the specific 'Mech(s) you piloted.
ATip26: General XP (GXP) is a universal type of XP, and unlike 'Mech XP (XP) is not tied to a specific 'Mech. GXP can be used to unlock Skill Nodes for any 'Mech you choose.
ATip27: Larger engines will allow your 'Mech to move faster. XL engines cost more, occupy more slots but weigh less.
ATip28: Mounting ammo into an easily destructible area is risky as unspent ammo can explode. Mitigate this risk with C.A.S.E.
ATip29: Effective use of the Command Wheel can turn the tide. Break a stalemate by issuing movement commands, or mark Enemy forces to give your Team critical intel.

BeagleProbe_desc: Increases sensor range, speeds up targeting data, and can detect shut down 'Mechs at close range. Counters ECM.
GuardianECM_desc: The G-ECM protects friendly units within 120m from electronic targeting systems.  The G-ECM can also counter the effects of an enemy G-ECM within the same 120m radius.
CCC_desc: Increases sensor and TAG laser range, zoom, and speeds up targeting data.
StandardArmorType_desc: Standard BattleMech armor that provides 32 points of protection per ton.
FerroFibrousType_desc: 12% more protection per ton, occupies 14 critical slots but weighs less.
StandardStructureType_desc: The internal “bones” of a 'Mech, uses standard materials and weighs 10% of the 'Mech’s maximum tonnage.
EndoSteelType_desc: Made from lighter endo-steel and weighing 5% of the 'Mech’s maximum tonnage but occupies 14 critical slots.
StandardHeatSinkType_desc: A standard heat sink that dissipates heat generated by the 'Mech's engine, weapon systems and the environment's ambient temperature.
DoubleHeatSinkType_desc: 40% more efficient than a Standard Heat Sink but weighing the same; requires triple the amount of space.
ArtemisType_desc: A targeting system that increases LRM and SRM accuracy to targets within LOS. Each ARTEMIS-enabled weapon takes one more ton and slot to equip. Disabled if sensors enter low signal state. Benefits do not stack with NARC.
DefaultSkins_desc: This is the default skin for this BattleMech.
DoubleHeatSink_MkI_desc: Increases heat dissipation per ton but takes up 3 critical slots.

ml_ArmorSlotMovable_Desc: Currently used by upgraded armor but will find another spot to use if this slot is needed.

pt_coolant_cooling_upgrade_desc: Increases the cooling effects of all Cool Shots by 20%.
pt_advanced_secondary_coolant_flush_desc: Upgrades Cool Shot 9 to do an additional 9 heat per second (for one second) cooling for a total of 18. Consumed on use.
Primary_coolant_flush_desc: Adds 6 heat per second (for one second) cooling to your 'Mech's cooling efficiency. Consumed on use.
Coolant_Flush_Secondary_Advanced_desc: Adds 2 heat per second cooling to your 'Mech's cooling efficiency for 7 seconds. Consumed on use.
Coolant_Flush_Secondary_desc: Adds 9 heat per second (for one second) cooling to your 'Mech's cooling efficiency. Consumed on use.
pt_advanced_artillery_desc: Replaces Artillery Strike. Calls in a barrage of long range artillery.  10 shells drop into the targeted area after a 4 second flight time delay.  Each shell does up to 165 points of damage to a Mech. Consumed on use.
pt_advanced_airstrike_desc: Replaces Air Strike. Calls in a fighter air strike on a targeted zone.  6 bombs drop into the targeted area after a 7 second flight time delay.  Each bomb does up to 165 points of damage to a Mech. Consumed on use.
pt_drone_upgrade_desc: Increases the amount of time a UAV is active by 15 seconds.
Artillery_Strike_desc: Calls in a barrage of long range artillery. 20 shells drop into the targeted circular area within a 75 meter radius for 6 seconds. Each shell deals 5 damage on impact. Consumed on Use.
Priority_Artillery_Strike_desc: Calls in a barrage of long range artillery. 20 shells drop into the targeted circular area within a 75 meter radius for 6 seconds. Each shell deals 5 damage on impact. Consumed on Use.
Air_Strike_desc: Calls in a fighter air strike on a targeted zone. 7 bombs drop into the targeted area. Each bombing run covers 125 meters towards the target direction. Each bomb does 10 damage on impact. Consumed on Use.
Priority_Air_Strike_desc: Calls in a fighter air strike on a targeted zone. 7 bombs drop into the targeted area. Each bombing run covers 125 meters towards the target direction. Each bomb does 10 damage on impact. Consumed on Use.

pt_capture_accelerator_desc: Increases the rate of capture by 15%.
pt_visionmode_disruptor_desc: Overloads any vision mode based on its feature to effectively blind the pilot temporarily.
pt_hide_damage_desc: Disrupts the enemy's damage information relating to the pilot's own 'Mech.
pt_advanced_zoom_desc: A Picture-in-Picture long range zoom with 4.4x magnification.
pt_friendly_defense_desc: Removes an enemy's lock off a friendly player and applies it to your own 'Mech.
pt_multi_target_desc: Allows targeting up to 2 enemy BattleMechs at one time.
pt_adv_multi_target_desc: Allows targeting up to 3 enemy BattleMechs at one time.
pt_targeting_delay_desc: Causes a 3% slowdown in target acquisition for any enemy 'Mech targeting your 'Mech.
pt_instant_signal_loss_desc: All targeting information and lock-ons are removed the moment you leave line-of-sight.
pt_disrupt_hud_desc: Static appears over enemy HUD and MFD displays while they are within close range of your 'Mech.
pt_disable_comms_desc: Disables the BattleGrid, text chat, commands of an enemy that is within range.  (Lance and company chat only)
pt_orbital_scan_desc: Allows the pilot to  send a request for a full battlefield scan.
pt_target_decay_desc: Increases the amount of time a BattleMech is trackable when it leaves line of sight to 2.75 seconds.
pt_adv_target_decay_desc: Increases the amount of time a BattleMech is trackable when it leaves line of sight to 3.5 seconds.
pt_s_unit_visionmodes_desc: Allows surveilance support units to use vision modes.
pt_airstrike_accuracy_desc: Decreases the area of bombardment by 20%.
pt_artillery_accuracy_desc: Decreases the area of bombardment by 20%.
pt_target_info_gathering_desc: Decreases the amount of time required for detailed target information by 25%.
pt_adv_target_info_gathering_desc: Critical damage to components is displayed on the targeted BattleMech in 3D world space.
pt_visionmode_enhance_desc: Decreases the noise of vision modes and increases the view distance by 10%.

tut_greeting_text_01: Greetings, and welcome to the MechWarrior Online tutorial system!  This tutorial will teach you how to pilot your 'Mech using the basic movement controls.
tut_throttledecay_text_01: For this tutorial, the option ‘Throttle Decay' has been locked into the ‘on’ state.\n\nWhen Throttle Decay is on, your 'Mech will move forward for as long as you hold '&m_increaseThrottle*'.  When you hold down '&m_decreaseThrottle*', your 'Mech will move backwards.  When you don't hold a key, your 'Mech will slow down until it comes to a halt.
tut_armlock_text_01: For this tutorial, the option 'Arm Lock' has been locked into the 'on' state.\n\nWhen Arm Lock is on, the weapons mounted on your 'Mech's arms will always aim at the same target as those mounted on your 'Mech's torso.  You will be unable to move and aim your 'Mech's arms independently.
tut_viewpoint_text_01:
As you can see, you’re viewing your 'Mech from a third person view.  That is because, for this tutorial, the 'Start In Third Person' option has been set to on.  When that option is on, you will start each match in third person view (after the startup sequence ends).  When it is off, you will start each match in first person view.

Regardless of which view you start the match in, you can switch your view at any time as long as your 'Mech isn’t powered down.  This is done by pressing '&thirdpersoncombatcam*'.

Try switching to first person now.
tut_viewpoint_text_02: In first person view, your view is more restricted but you receive more information on your HUD.  Notice the minimap at the bottom of your screen.\n\nNow switch back to third person view.
tut_viewpoint_text_03: Good.  One more thing to keep in mind during a real battle is that, while you are in third person view, there is a camera drone hovering behind your 'Mech.  So, while you may be able to see a little bit more of the battlefield, your own position could be given away if your enemies see your drone.
tut_look_text_01: Now it’s time you learn how to move your 'Mech.  Let’s begin by focusing on your 'Mech’s torso.  The torso can rotate independently from the legs, allowing you to look around and aim.  To twist the torso from side to side, and to pitch up and down, use your mouse.\n\nIf you need to recenter your torso, you can press '&m_torso_centre*' and your torso will match your legs’ alignment.  Alternatively, you can press '&m_legs_centre*' and your legs will match your torso’s alignment.
tut_look_text_02: Above your 'Mech you can see your compass.  The triangles show the direction your 'Mech is facing.  The upper triangle is the direction that your 'Mech’s torso is facing while the lower triangle is the direction your 'Mech’s legs are headed.\n\nTry moving your 'Mech’s torso and then recentering it.
tut_look_text_03: When you turn with your 'Mech’s legs, you turn the entire 'Mech; legs, torso, and all.  To turn your 'Mech to the left, press '&m_turnleft*'.  To turn your 'Mech to the right, press '&m_turnright*'.\n\nPractice turning your 'Mech in place.
tut_throttle_text_01: As you've been told earlier, 'Throttle Decay' has been turned on.  This means that your 'Mech will only move forward (or backward) when you hold down the control to increase (or decrease) your throttle.\n\nAt the bottom of your HUD is the throttle meter.  You can use this to see where your throttle is set as well as your current speed.
tut_throttle_text_02: To move forward, hold '&m_increaseThrottle*'.\n\nTo move backward, hold '&m_decreaseThrottle*'.
tut_throttle_text_03: Try out your navigation skills by proceeding to the first waypoint.  Look for the waypoint icon on your compass and head towards it.  The waypoint will appear in the world as a column of blue smoke.
tut_throttle_text_04: Good job.  Remember that, as you pilot your 'Mech, its torso is capable of looking around independently of the direction the legs are walking.\n\nPractice your skills by traveling to three more waypoints.
tut_throttle_text_05: Great!  You've been making your first steps towards becoming an expert MechWarrior.
tut_jumpjets_text_01: Now you’ll learn about jump jets.  Jump jets are thrusters that can be equipped on to certain 'Mechs, allowing them to fly into the air for short periods of time.  The longer you fire the jump jets, the higher you'll go.\n\nFuel is limited, but will refill while you're on the ground.  The meter to the right of the throttle is the jump jet meter, and it will show you how much fuel you have remaining.
tut_jumpjets_text_02: Jump jets are activated by pressing '&m_jump_jet*'.  If you do so while your 'Mech is standing still, it will rise straight up.  If you press it while moving forwards or backwards, the momentum will carry your 'Mech in the same direction while it rises into the air.\n\nNow, try jump jetting straight up.  Remember to leave some fuel for the landing or you'll risk damage to your 'Mech's legs.
tut_jumpjets_text_03: That was easy.  Now it's time to try something a little more difficult.\n\nUse your jump jets to maneuver onto a waypoint that you normally couldn't reach by walking.
tut_jumpjets_text_04: Excellent.  Mastering jump jets will add an extra dimension to your tactics in the field.
tut_presets_text_01: Now it's time to learn how to use preset throttle levels.  These options are available to you even when Throttle Decay is turned on.\n\nIf you press '&m_throttle_set_10*', you'll set the throttle to 10%; if you press '&m_throttle_set_20*', you'll set it to 20%, and so on.  '&m_throttle_set_100*' sets the throttle to 100%.  These throttle settings will remain in place until you change them again.  Also, you should note that your 'Mech won't actually move if your throttle setting would cause it to go less than 15 kph.
tut_presets_text_02: To bring your 'Mech to a full stop, press '&m_fullStop*' or, when Throttle Decay is on, press and release the button to increase or decrease your throttle.  This will instantly set your throttle to zero and your 'Mech will naturally decelerate until it comes to a stop.\n\nPractice using these throttle presets.  Use them to bring your 'Mech to 50% throttle, and then 100%.  After you reach 100%, press '&m_fullStop*' to come to a stop.
tut_presets_text_03: Terrific!  Remember that in a real battle these presets are an easy way of quickly changing your throttle setting.
tut_conclusion_text_01: Congratulations!  You've completed the tutorial.  If you’d like to continue practicing, you can continue to do so here.  Select Testing Grounds on the Home Menu and select a map to try out and click OK.

@SpeakerC_Kickers_desc: The declaration of demise is waiting at the twitch of your finger.

@SpeakerE_LunchTruck_desc: An excessive blast signaling the liberation of yet another adversary.

pi_440: A rich world of sprawling cities and major space ports, the wealth has come from official (and not so official) trading with a myriad of back-water Combine worlds that almost completely surround it.
pi_1796: Covered extensively by the lush Solun Jungle, Jarett's primary claim to fame is as the third target of the mysterious Minnestoa Tribe that struck in early 2826.
pi_548: Buckminster went from a relatively obscure agricultural world to instant power and strategic importance when it was made a Prefecture Capital in the early years of the 31st century.
pi_785: Three continents run north to south on Thule, creating one of bounty, one of scorching deserts, and the southernmost a continent of frigid ice.
pi_1590: A frequent target of water raids for centuries, New Caledonia is dominated by rocky plains. Redfev, the capital, is also its industrial center and home to the planet's main spaceport.
pi_927: Colonized in 2338 by the Rim Worlds Republic, this water-rich world was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth at the fall of the Star League as the RWR was destroyed.
pi_1627: Left relatively untouched from the horrors of the Succession Wars, Bessarabia is home to the Sirocco's Den, a massive meandering dune composed of unusual crystalline structures.
pi_933: Relatively industrialized for a Periphery border world, Chateau retains remnants of Star League-era infrastructure in its vast transportation arteries linking the capital of Romul to its major industrial center.
pi_1624: A frigid world of a perpetual twilight due to nuclear bombardment during the Succession Wars, native Dalkeithians have a natural resistance to the effects of some types of radiation.
pi_1588: An Eden-like world--yet resource scarce--the Star League era saw the Cosmopolis megaplex arise, catering to the ultra rich that frequented Dell's brilliant beaches and flora/fauna rich islands.
pi_1613: Of little strategic importance, Domain is a pastoral world of gently rolling hills and wide plains; the capital, Kusson, lies nestled in the foothills of the Kusson Mountains.
pi_851: Infamous within the Lyran Commonwealth, Duke Reynolds of Fatima's court was thrown into turmoil when one of his nobleman was responsible for the assassination of Archon Alister Steiner in 2467.
pi_1614: A small-ish planet lacking in significant resources, the original colonists included "Fort" in the name due to the massive ranges of mountains that make any attempts at raids undesirable.
pi_1645: Once a beautiful world during the heyday of the Star League, the planet has since moved into a volcanic phase rendering life on 3 of the 5 continents impossible and launching a nascent ice age.
pi_477: A world of very little land-mass, the economy of Maestu is based almost exclusively on fishing and ranching for those relatively rare stretches of good land on the various islands.
pi_985: Meacham is home to a large, continent-spanning desert where temperatures soar to near 70 degrees Celsius, making them virtually uninhabitable, even for a tech-heavy colony.
pi_1592: A planet of modest wealth and means, Planting's main population centers are located aground the agro-industrial complexes of the Dantron-Sontor-Belex TriCities.
pi_1610: Headquarters of Rastaban Agricultural Products, this colossal exporter of quick-growing grains--primarily to the Draconis Combine--own five trillion acres spread over five worlds.
pi_952: A quiet border world with the Free Rasalhague Republic, more well-off military personnel in the region are known to hop a planet on R&R just to visit Sally's Bar and Grill in the capital of Vesinur.
pi_8: In 3024 the LCAF pushed the last Kurita forces off this large industrialized world. Despite the decades, significant portions of the world still retain the scars of Succession Wars conflict.
pi_1616: Originally named Perrot when it was colonized during mankind's first diaspora to the stars, the Draconis Combine renamed the world after it was conquering during the Second Succession War.
pi_728: Suk II is home to several key, rare metal deposits that have solicited raids for centuries. Those same metals have tainted most of the worlds water, making the inhabitants a hardy stock.
pi_1587: Svarstaad is volcanically active with only a few hardy settlers; descendants of migrants from the Principality of Rasalhague who were unable to return after it was conquered by the Draconis Combine.
pi_706: Capital of the Tamar Pack, this world has been hotly contested with many conflicts over the centuries, including when House Kurita razed the War Academy of Tamar in 2915.
pi_1142: Founded in 3019 by an ex-Captain in one of House Davion's 'Mech regiments, Santander's World boasts one of the most vicious pirate bands operating in the Periphery.
pi_893: Star's End is known for its germanium deposits (essential for JumpShip construction), as well as its bandits (the infamous Morgan Fletcher and his Belt Pirates).
pi_1488: Occupied by the descendants of Stefan Amaris' supporters, it's a xenophobic world where the Von Strang family zealously keep the population in servitude repairing hundreds of fortifications.
pi_1125: A lush, tropical planet maintained in its pristine wilderness state by the pacifist Inheritors. Rumors of a secret, ancient Star League facility has brought prospectors and raiders alike to clash with the inhabitants.
pi_1619: Home to a pacifist philosophical movement called the Inheritors, Manaringaine is kept in a pristine wilderness state, with inhabitants living in primitive villages for their cause.
pi_1641: A planet with very little commercial or geological value, it's only occupied by members of the Inheritors who migrated from the nearby Manaringaine to spread their philosophy of pristine wildernesses.
pi_1784: A colony of the Elysian Fields, the world takes the usual Inheritor pacifist ideals of this region to its logical conclusion with absolutely no weapons of any kind allowed.
pi_1468: A desolate Periphery world, one of its main exports is an obsidian sand for industrial usage.
pi_1542: A barren, thinly populated arid world. Few settlements exist that aren't heavily fortified, sprinkled only lightly across vast deserts plains that cover most of its surface. Rumored home of a verbose robotic AI.
pi_921: A cold planet covered in layers of ice and snow, the few hardy souls on world scratch out a meager living in a thin belt of tundra near the equator.
pi_922: Colonized by the Rim Worlds Republic in 2338, its few, desperate citizens still lay claim to that ancient tie to greatness in every drunken brawl.
pi_941: Erewhon was colonized by a radical sect who believe that a fiction novel published on ancient Terra actually holds the key to a Utopian society; outsiders are routinely lynched for "corruption."
pi_1489: Named "Last Chance" by inhabitants driven to the absolute edge of the Periphery trying to escape the Succession Wars, it's a volcanic heavy world with a tainted atmosphere requiring rebreathers.
pi_1141: A "world botany" science outpost of the Star League, the centuries since the fall of that empire has left Ferris with only a single claim to fame: large packs of Terran wolverines.
pi_1583: Another of the few gems in the Oberon Confederation bandit kingdom, Gustrell features vast tracts of dense forests, the largest of which is the Pellembroke Woods.
pi_1140: One of the richest worlds in the Bandit Kingdoms, Oberon VI is warm and temperate, with large deposits of coal and gold. Since the 2900s, it has been heavily industrialized (for a Periphery world).
pi_1539: A frozen world of towering glaciers and rock-hard seas, Sigurd is a stark, bleak wasteland covered in spires of ice and mounds of snow, whose inhabitants reside in thick-walled clay houses.
pi_1563: A chaotic cluster of asteroids orbiting a star, The Rock is home to hardy souls looking to mine the dangerous-to-extract resources, or stay off of even Periphery realm's radars.
pi_1515: Rumors of a Star League cache that allowed the Blackstone family to found Blackstone Industries on the planet Inarcs have left the Periphery world of Blackstone heavily raided for centuries.
pi_1562: Originally with the Rim Worlds Republic, Crellacor joined the Oberon Confederation after the Republic's destruction in hopes of upholding lost ideals, only to fall into banditry in the ensuing centuries.
pi_1560: Controlled by a petty tyrant, the ruler of the Oberon Confederation allows him to remain as the ex-DCMS officer is more depraved than most, making him useful.
pi_1572: Paulus Prime is a massive world; stretching scientific boundaries of what can be a planet and still retain an atmosphere. But its lack of significant resources has left it only a curiosity.
pi_1524: A hostile world of extreme weather patterns, it has some of the most voracious tornados in human-occupied space. Only the large gem deposits keep migratory workers returning to this hellhole.
pi_215: Colonized before the start of the Age of War, Accrington would originally form part of the interstellar proto-nation of the Federation of Skye, which would eventually join the Lyran Commonwealth.
pi_1737: Capital of the Alshain Military District, this important world also boasts the Alshain Weapons factory, along with a military base and supply debot located in the Dabbateur Pleateau region.
pi_677: Colonized during the First Exodus from Terra, this small, realtively un-important world missed being annexed by the Tamar Pact; ultimately absorbed just by shifting borders into the Draconis Combine.
pi_1458: Atreus became the capital of The Free Worlds League in 2271. It's single moon "Wendigo" is notable for being the location of the headquarters of "SAFE" the league's intelligence agency.
pi_201: Settled during the First Exodus from Terra, it has changed hands numerous times during the Succession Wars, leaving--even to this day--various wastelands and derelics across its surface.
pi_327: Originally a bountiful agricultural world, a near miss with a rogue asteroid caused the moon's orbit to turn erratic, devastating the planet and leaving it a desolate wasteland where only a few dare stay.
pi_1066: Camlann was settled in the early years of the 25th century by the Azami, a fiercly independent people of Muslim culture that would eventually compose the infamous Arkab Legions.
pi_19: During the Amaris Civil War the SLS Nelson, a Black Lion Battlecruiser was scuttled in a long elliptical orbit. Later the Free worlds retrieved the SLS Nelson with the World of Blake and renamed it FWLS Xanthos.
pi_1793: When colonized in the late 24th century, it was one of the furthest-occupied planets from Terra. Having lost that title centuries ago, it remains an obscure, albiet pleasant world.
pi_520: Lack of clean water almost destroyed the colony before a new filtration system saved the population and gave rise to the Commonwealth's large water purifier manufacturer, Water Pure Industries.
pi_1787: Courchevel is a temperate world with a good-sized population and industrial base. However, it's most famous for the Dragon's Rift, one of the largest canyons in known space.
pi_13: During the Fourth Succession War, Denebola was invaded from the Tikonov Free Republic in 3029.  The System was abandoned by Janos Marik later on in the war only to find out the LCAF tricked him to commit forces elsewhere in the region.
pi_24: Most of the native lifeforms are tasty and nutritious and has provided much of the world's economy.
pi_1704: Eguilles was colonized late in the 26th century as the Star League created a boom economy allowing for even resource poor worlds to warrant opening; its population and economy remain small.
pi_6: Freedom was the spark that led to the collapse of the Terran Alliance. With their declaration of independence from the Terran authority Sevren, Morningside and Summit also withdrew membership in the Terran Alliance leading to the Outer Reaches Rebellion.
pi_1452: Gibbs III or known simply as Gibbs is the home of the Lockheed Corporation. In orbit above Gibbs is a major Manufacturing complex ran by Ioto Galactic Enterprises.
pi_1518: Best known for its home of Defiance Industries BattleMech Factories in the Myoo Mountains, Herperus II is the largest remaining BattleMech Factory in the entire Inner Sphere and is the target of numerous attacks from other houses over the centuries.
pi_1740: Settled early in the 27th century, the planet is currently part of Duke Hassid Ricol's--governor of the Alshain Military District--personal duchy.
pi_168: Settled in 2189, Liao was a planet with wide expanses of grasslands and little else. The planet quickly grew into a major producer of livestock for the local star systems.  The pride of Liao is Eridani Stallions that are very sought after from buyers.
pi_776: Luthien is the capital of the Draconis Combine and is the empires largest industrial world. Called "Operation Dragon Slayer" in 2052 the combined forces from Clan Smoke Jaguar and Nova Cat attacked Luthien. The Clan forces were forced to withdraw.
pi_1745: Surviving the ravages of the Succession Wars by having little resources or industrial capacity, Marawi's capital is still a wonder as it seamlessly messes with the mighty forest surrounding it.
pi_1604: Only Star League-era terraforming managed to tame the atmosphere of this incredibly resource rich world, but with the loss of that technology the toxic atmosphere is slowly returning.
pi_21: Marik was settled in 2139 by Antonin Marik and is the ancestral landholder for the Marik family. Over the centuries the planet was spared the ravages of war due to its location. Marik served as the headquarters of the III Corps during the Star League.
pi_16: The Star League established several Castles Brian's on Muphrid, but they were all but destroyed just after the fall of the Star League. Rumors persist for centuries that some are still intact and groups of explorers have sought to seek them out.
pi_287: A virulent plague broke out in 2512 on the planet. One of the victims was First Prince William Davion who suffered for a week before dying.  After his death, he passed the seal to Alexander Davion's Sister, Laura Davion.
pi_2: New Earth - formerly known as Tau Ceti IV  was the destination of humanity's first manned mission to another star system when the TAS Pathfinder found Tau Ceti IV in 2108.
pi_17: Northwind was purchased by Clan Stuart during the first Exodus and named for the Clan's old home Scotland. In 2362 the Clan Elders elected to raise a standing army and created the Northwind Highlanders that became an elite mercenary unit to this day.
pi_25: During the Amaris Civil War two, SLDF warships were so heavily damaged and crashed onto the surface of the planet during a desperate battle vs the defenders.
pi_546: Utterly forgettable for half a millenium, Phalan instantly rose to prominence in 3013 when a large deposit of high-grade diamonds essential for the manufacture of BattleMech armor was discovered.
pi_4: Colonized in 2271 Pike IV was settled for its large mineral wealth, creating two societies. The "Highlanders" and the "lowlanders". Both Factions have a "us vs them" attitude that led to several conflicts on the planet fighting over resources.
pi_1802: The people of Polcenigo live under the iron rule of a tyrannical and corrupt government, where every aspect of their lives is controlled. That, along with heavy bribery, keeps the ISF off world.
pi_15: During the Star League Procyon was home to a major naval base and several Castles Brion scattered throughout the planet. Most notable was a Battletech factory owned by the Brigadier Corporation.
pi_22: Identified as a world rich with raw materials, corporations seeking to exploit the wealth of the planet.  This made the planet a target during the Succession Wars for control of the planet.
pi_697: Granted independence on March 13, 3034 by Comstar and the Draconis Combine was short lived after being overrun by the Clan invasion of Clan Wolf and Clan Ghost Bear.
pi_91: During the Second Succession war, Robinson was invaded by Kurita forces to freeze up the Davion military on the border between the two realms.  The assault was quickly repelled and had little effect on the war.
pi_5: Rochelle is one of the first worlds settled during Terran Alliance. Its large amount of resources and infrastructure were all but destroyed during the Succession Wars and from then on the planet has seen a cycle of decline.
pi_844: With a dark, cold atmosphere and half its surface covered in ice, Rubigen is a hostile world, but home to a hardy people used to a tough life centered around the planet's two small seas.
pi_7: A helish world wracked by extreme cold and erupting volcanoes, its abundant resources created a thriving chemical industry, and also made it an priority target for raids during the Succession Wars.
pi_20: When discovered and settled by humanity, Saffel was going through a bitter ice age.  With no support from the core worlds after the Outer Reaches Rebellion many died of the harsh winters on the planet.
pi_1716: Though covered mostly in scorching deserts, Setubal was settled for access to abundant, clean subterranean water that could be mined and shipped off world to water-poor planets in the region.
pi_1747: With little strategic value and minor resources, Sheliak's only claim-to-fame is its passionate support of the ancient Terran sport of North American-rules football, which draws some interplanetary tourists.
pi_18: After the First Exodus from Terra the planet attracted the religious group known as the Exituri. The Exituri was a blend of many religious sects who choose to leave Terra to create a theocratic society.
pi_1684: Founded late in the Star League era, Shirotori is a verdant world of major island chains, with its three largest cities of Massona, Brusk and capital Meijer holding the majority of the planet's population.
pi_253: Sian is the capital of the Capellan Confederation, also is the political and industrial might of the empire. In 2367 the capital was transferred to Sian from Capella after it was devasted by planetary bombardment.
pi_279: Solaris VII is the known for its six major arenas and mech gladiatorial games. Lives and fortunes are changed on a daily basis from gambling & mech games, once a year a Grand Tournament is held to crown a champion.
pi_1779: While not heavily populated, Soverzene has been mined extensively for centuries, leaving it an environmental disaster. It still remains the backbone of raw materials for the Alshain Military District.
pi_11: Tall Trees is best known for a Virulent Plague that wiped out everyone in 2966. The plague was known as New Tierra del Fuego II.
pi_1: Terra is the home planet of humanity and home of the Star League from 2571 to 2781. Terra has been the capital of several interstellar nations and is the most advanced industrialized planet in the Inner Sphere.
pi_984: Tharkad was spared the horrors of the Succession wars but was the final battle of the FedCom Civil War of Supporters of Victor Steiner-Davion and his sister Katherine. After months of fighting, Peter killed his great-aunt ending the Battle of Tharkad.
pi_1762: Though Thessalonika boast abundent flora and fauna, it is better known for putting the People's Protection service on the map when they foiled an assassination attempt against the Planetary Chairman.
pi_9: First colonized by the Terran Alliance in 2271, Thorin was a beautiful world with rich resources, but early efforts were thwarted by bull sized predators. Now zoning laws were passed to help preserve Thorin to its natural beauty.
pi_23: The Capellan Confederation annexed Tigress after the fall of the Star League. The planet has a well-educated population and also was a very highly industrialized economy.
pi_999: The largest Mech engagement in history took place on May 1st 3052. Comstar forces clashed against 25 Galaxies of Clan Forces for domination of the Inner Sphere. With the defeat of the clans, lead to the Truce of Tukayyid that lasted for 15 years.
pi_12: Zurich IV is the fourth planet of a K5V primary star and was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra. In 2240 Zurich became independent from the Terran Alliance.

MC_IS_Davion: The Department of Mercenary Relations extends a short-term contract for your hire in the defense of the free peoples of the Federated Commonwealth.\n\nField Marshal Grissom Miller
LC_IS_Davion: Congratulations from the Department of Mercenary Relations on passing muster for this offer of a long-term contract. Your acumen and sensibilities are an asset that will greatly aid the Federated Commonwealth.
MC_IS_Kurita: For the glory of the Dragon, you are honored with a short-term contract under the auspice of the Professional Soldiery Liaison to serve the Combine as needed alongside the Pillar of Steel.
LC_IS_Kurita: The Draconis Combine Professional Soldiery Liaison extends you privilege of a long-term contract. Your swords will be first among equals as you guard the borders of our great realm!
MC_IS_Liao: Accept this short-term contract from the Capellan Command Council. Your sellswords will protect the Chancellor and his magnificent Capellan Confederation from his enemies.
LC_IS_Liao: You are bestowed the high gift of a Charter you will accept for long-term employment for the greater good of the glorious Capellan Confederation.\n\nCapellan Command Council
MC_IS_Marik: Well-met accomplished soldier. The League Central Coordination And Command salutes your bravery in accepting a short-term contract to protect the peoples of the Free World League.
LC_IS_Marik: The League Central Coordination And Command welcomes your acceptance of a long-term contract with the first Great House. Your reputation and service will be celebrated by the Free Worlds League.
MC_IS_Rasalhague: The KungsArmé Mercenary Relations extends a short-term contract. If you accept, you will adhere to all stipulations within the contract for the duration of your employment.\n\nWelcome.
LC_IS_Rasalhague: The KungsArmé Mercenary Relations welcomes an acceptance of a long-term contract. As with our short-term contracts, you must adhere to all stipulations.\n\nJoin for freedom.
CR_DD_IS_Liao: Swine! Your defeat at the hands of the Celestial Wisdom’s enemies is a disgrace. Capellan children would defend their homeland with more dedication and skill than your failed defense.
CR_AV_IS_Steiner: Congratulations! Your victory is a testament to your battle acumen, and instills confidence in your abilities. Your tactics during the initial attack were particularly effective and will be studied at great depth in acknowledgement of your skill and prowess under adverse conditions.
MC_Is_Steiner: A short-term contract for your hire is extended by the Department of Mercenary Relations for the defense of the free peoples of the Federated Commonwealth.\n\nField Marshal Grissom Miller
LC_IS_Steiner: The Department of Mercenary Relations offers congratulations on passing muster for this offer of a long-term contract. Your sensibilities and acumen are an asset that will greatly aid the Federated Commonwealth.
MC_Clan_Smoke_Jaguar: Accept this bondtroth of short-term service with the Touman of Clan Smoke Jaguar. Khan Lincoln Osis is watching and will mete out justice equal to your courage and prowess.
LC_Clan_Smoke_Jaguar: You are saabtakha, adopted to become a warrior of Clan Smoke Jaguar for the specified time frame. Jaguar springs; Jaguar claws; Jaguar tastes: may you emulate the Founder’s favorite totem.
MC_Clan_Jade_Falcon: Elias Crichell, Khan of Clan Jade Falcon, guardians of the Founder’s vision, offers you bondtroth of short-term service. The eyes of the Falcon are ever upon your battles.
LC_Clan_Jade_Falcon: Embrace the fire of the first Falcon; put on the mantle of stubbornness. You are adopted, saabtakha, into Clan Jade Falcon. Accept the will to remember during your service and you shall fly with us above all others.
MC_Clan_Wolf: Accept this bondtroth for short-term service in the Clan the Founder chose to mingle his blood. Khan Ulric Kerensky patiently awaits the record you will forge on future fields of battle.
LC_Clan_Wolf: If you accept this adoption, saabtakha, for long-term service with Clan Wolf, you must be ever vigilant. Willing to lope for long miles, silent and patient. Yet strike in an instant when the time arrives for action.
MC_Clan_Ghost_Bear: By the hand of Bjorn Jorgensson, accept this bondtroth for short-term service with Clan Ghost Bear. May the ursus within arise as needed: for protection, for attack, for the family.
LC_Clan_Ghost_Bear: The courage of Tseng; the foresight of Jorgensson. You are saabtakha, adopted into Clan Ghost Bear. Bring these attributes to your long-term service and you will be honored among our warriors.

ui_MercContractText:
Contract Duration Bonuses:

7 - Days: 0% Additional LR

Note: Contract bonuses are applied to the base amount of the loyalty reputation earned and does not compound with other loyalty reputation bonuses.
CR_AV_IS_Davion: Congratulations on your victory. Your tactics during the initial attack were particularly effective and will be studied at great depth in acknowledgement of your skill and prowess under adverse conditions. This is a testament to your battle acumen.
CR_DV_IS_Davion: The tactics and strategies employed were exceptionally effective! The peoples of the Federated Commonwealth extend their heart-felt thanks for your successful defense.
CR_AD_IS_Davion: The nature of your failed assault leads us to question your competency. Intel is pouring over the battleroms from your attack. We strongly urge a review of said footage and implementing necessary changes to ensure success in the future.
CR_DD_IS_Davion: Your failed defense leaves much to be desired and calls your abilities into question. After all, when the peoples of the Federated Commonwealth feel the sting of enemies grounding on their worlds, it cannot but elicit such a reaction. In the strongest terms we suggest a reassessment of your battle strategies.
CR_AV_IS_Kurita: Honor to you, for your glorious assault. The warriors of the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery salute your attack and recognize a warrior worthy of respect. May the sun never set upon your battlefield acuity, nor your unflinching bravery to expand the might of the Dragon.
CR_DV_IS_Kurita: A staunch defense worthy of a haiku. The Professional Soldiery Liaison recognizes your exceptional service in defending the realm against enemies jealous of the Dragon’s might and majesty. May your blade always shine and your honor never fade as you continue in our service.
CR_AD_IS_Kurita: The lack of discipline and battlefield awareness displayed in your failed assault is a stain upon your reputation and honor.
CR_DD_IS_Kurita: The blood of the Dragon was spilt this day in your abysmal defense. The cries of the innocent mock your honor and astuteness on the field of battle. Allowing our enemies one meter of ground is unacceptable. Future defenses must erase your stain, or risk a permanent black mark on your honor.
CR_AV_IS_Liao: Under the Celestial Wisdom’s hand your assault was foreordained for victory! A testament to your skills. Long will your victories under the Chancellor’s hands be celebrated.
CR_DV_IS_Liao: The prudence of the Celestial Wisdom shines forth in bringing your skills to the bulwark of the empire. Your intuitive defense saved Capellan blood and vaulted your name in reputation across the Inner Sphere. Continue such feats and you may receive a direct visit from his blessed personage!
CR_AD_IS_Liao: Inbred! Servitors would demonstrate greater acumen in an assault than your clumsy attempts at battle tactics. You shall lead the next assault and the results must be a victory or prepare for the consequences.
CR_DV_IS_Steiner: The peoples of the Federated Commonwealth extends their heart-felt thanks for your successful defense! The tactics and strategies employed were exceptionally effective and reinforce the truth of your abilities.
CR_AD_IS_Steiner: While Intel is pouring over the battleroms from your attack, the nature of your failed assault leads us to question your abilities. We strongly urge a review of your own orders and implement necessary changes to ensure success in the future.
CR_DD_IS_Steiner: When the peoples of the Federated Commonwealth feel the sting of enemies grounding on their worlds, it cannot but elicit a strong reaction. Your failed defense leaves much to be desired, and calls your abilities into question. We suggest in the strongest terms a reassessment of your battle strategies.
CR_AV_IS_Marik: Your victory in the scouting raid is a triumph for all the peoples of the Free Worlds League. The League Central Coordination And Command commends your skill and dedication.
CR_DV_IS_Marik: Your spirited defense of the peoples of the Free Worlds League will be heralded from world to world as news of your victory spreads.  The League Central Coordination And Command congratulates you for your valiant efforts in protecting the borders of the first Great House.
CR_AD_IS_Marik: The League Central Coordination And Command postulates a need to review operational parameters due to your latest failed assault. Such a review will uncover compromising elements and allow you to ensure victory for the next assignment. While disappointed, we are confident in your future success.
CR_DD_IS_Marik: Your failed defense has left peoples of the Free Worlds League in harms way. The League Central Coordination And Command condemns your botched service and urges—in the strongest terms possible—a reevaluation of your combat doctrine to ensure future defenses will result in victory.
CR_AV_IS_Rasalhague: The proof of your loyalty in successfully executing your assault is welcomed. If more of your brethren demonstrate such professionalism in their service, the citizens of the Free Rasalhague Republic may yet change their perspectives concerning your value. Well done.
CR_DV_IS_Rasalhague: We are surprisingly pleased at your effective defense of the citizens of the Free Rasalhague Republic. Your skill and dedication to the Republic are traits to be emulated. May you continue such exemplary performance in all future battles.
CR_AD_IS_Rasalhague: We express deep—though unsurprised—disappointment at your lackluster assault. That you failed to achieve what our warriors accomplished while beset on all sides and under the aegis of a newly free nation…pray you are able to prove your abilities in future battles.
CR_DD_IS_Rasalhague: This is an outrage and the Free Rasalhague Republic citizens deserve better. Your botched defense mirrors a long line of failures of your so-called ‘professional’ soldier brethren. You will keep all personnel on reservation between deployments and your next defense will be a success.
CR_AV_Clan_Smoke_Jaguar: Glory to you warrior for your triumphant assault! Your prowess matches the smoke jaguar, whom you emulate with claw and spring and blood. The Touman watches and grins the bared teeth of victory. You honor your blood this day…long may you be remembered for your service this day.
CR_DV_Clan_Smoke_Jaguar: Seyla. Your brilliant defense of Clan Smoke Jaguar holdings is worthy of praise. You do your blood honor as the skills you espouse showcase your battlefield worthiness to fight alongside the warriors of our Touman. You may yet earn a line in The Remembrance for your great deeds this day.
CR_AD_Clan_Smoke_Jaguar: Savashri! First year sibkin can execute a better assault than your travesty of a deployment. Your enemies rejoice at your defeat. Spurn your blood. Mock Clan Smoke Jaguar. Khan Lincoln Osis will not accept weakness in any warriors, especially you. Seize the next victory, or you will be forgotten.
CR_DD_Clan_Smoke_Jaguar: You belittle the oaths you have taken in your failed defense. Solahma warriors ragged with their last breath in age show more spirit. Pray you are not called out in a Circle of Equals for your failure; as surely as The Founder forged the Clans you would be destroyed. Victory next time, warrior!
CR_AV_Clan_Jade_Falcon: Your brilliant assault is a testament to your skills and honors the blood that flows in your veins. Turkina’s eyes shine bright; her claws tear fresh; her wings fly high for you this day, warrior. The Founder’s vision sees an echo in your battlefield prowess. Long may your shadow join the Falcon’s wings.
CR_DV_Clan_Jade_Falcon: Well bargained and done, warrior. You superbly orchestrated your cutdown, selected your battlefield, and executed a defense that sent your opponent fleeing in shame. The warriors of the Clan Jade Falcon Touman salute you for your prowess and the ease with which you let all enemies know of Falcon strength.
CR_AD_Clan_Jade_Falcon: Freebirth! You sully the mighty Clan Jade Falcon—the Founder’s dream incarnate—with your lackluster skills. Your assault was in shambles before the attack even began. You failed to grasp our nathaculor—the strike of the unswerving sword. Failure to heed Falcon tactics in the future will end in your misery.
CR_DD_Clan_Jade_Falcon: Our enemies have poisoned Clan Jade Falcon soil with their mere presence, all due to your ineptitude! Fledgling warriors fresh into an Eyrie Cluster demonstrate greater acumen than you have today. Your failed defense is a stain on your blood you will long work to cleanse. Khan Elias Crichell is watching, and is most displeased with your service.
CR_AV_Clan_Wolf: Though freeborn, your blood sings true, trothkin. Your magnificent assault was filled with all the rage and fury of the best Wolf warriors. Yet tempered with the knowledge of when to relent, when to feint, and when to seize victory despite apparent defeat. A skill other Clan’s warriors sorely lack.
CR_DV_Clan_Wolf: The best defense is a better offense. A saying spoken by many, but few can execute. Honor to you trothkin, for a victorious defense that emulates the best of Clan tactics. The warriors of the Clan Wolf Touman howl in your honor this day as you let all Clansmen know not all of the best warriors are trueborn.
CR_AD_Clan_Wolf: Khan Ulric Kerensky is disappointed in your failed assault. Bowing to the pressure of chaos and the fog of war that engulfs any battlefield. Your previous acuity, none-the-less, shows your skills remain true, though untapped for this battle. Seize upon your past victories to emulate them for the future.
CR_DD_Clan_Wolf: Wolf blood was spilled this day in your disastrous defense. Blood that calls for vengeance. But the Wolf does not cull from the pack in the heat of battle. Your history marks you as a warrior worthy of your service with our Clan. Remember that and seize victory on another day and the clamor for vengeance with slack.
CR_AV_Clan_Ghost_Bear: Ursus roars at your brilliant assault, warrior. The mighty ghost bear acknowledges battle acumen, regardless of its source. Your family in Clan Ghost Bear rejoice at your success and embrace the honor you bring. Long may the foresight of Jorgensson be found in your victories to come.
CR_DV_Clan_Ghost_Bear: There is no greater glory than protecting the family. Your exemplar defense of Clan Ghost Bear holdings heralds your ristar status loud and clear. You are a warrior to be watched; a warrior to be tested; a warrior to fight alongside. You reflect back to our own Clansmen the courage of Tseng. Seyla.
CR_AD_Clan_Ghost_Bear: Such a debacle as this failed assault mocks the might of the bear. Khan Bjorn Jorgensson feels spurned after accepting your service, as do all warriors of the Clan Ghost Bear Touman. Accept again our embrace and the skills we offer and ensure victory for the family.
CR_DD_Clan_Ghost_Bear: There is no greater shame, warrior. You spilled the blood of the family in your travesty of a defense. The great ghost bear is slow to move, yet when that moment arrives, erupts with terrible fury. Ensure your future defenses protect Clan Ghost Bear lest we bring that fury against you.
