tut_comm_801: Humanity has spread out amongst the stars - bringing their hopes, their fears, and their wars
tut_comm_802: The Great Houses and Clans vie for territory and honor using gigantic fighting machines known as - BattleMechs
tut_comm_803: You, as a child of that conflict,
tut_comm_804: Are about to join that war...
tut_comm_805: Sim Control to Captain Adams - Ready for another one?
tut_comm_806: More meat for the grinder? - Just patch me through.
tut_comm_807: Welcome Recruit to your first taste of iron and steel.
tut_comm_808: My job is to make it a little less likely for you to crash and burn the moment you step on the battlefield.
tut_comm_809: Doubt me not, you will be ripped to shreds until you master your 'Mech and learn to fight as part of a team.
tut_comm_810: You're in hundreds of tons of steel and death on two legs.
tut_comm_812: For now we'll run you through the basics. You can come back later for advanced training.
tut_comm_813: Let's drop you down here where you won't get your ass shot off right away.
tut_comm_814: Yeah, that's me.  I'm just gonna sit back here and make sure that....  hang on a sec...
tut_comm_815: ... nobody sneaks up on you and spoils your day.
tut_comm_816: My name is Julias H. Adams.
tut_comm_818: I am in charge of this Academy.
tut_comm_820: I am in charge of this training simulator.
tut_comm_101: You're sitting on top of a fusion reactor in a multi-ton war machine the size of a building, time to learn how to use it.
tut_comm_102: Right then! Let's power up that BattleMech.
tut_comm_103: This is your augmented training HUD. On your right the Training Roadmap... it lets you know how you're progressing.
tut_comm_104: On your left, the Checklist. It shows your objectives and activities.
tut_comm_105: When an entry lights up, it means you're doing something right! carry on!
tut_comm_106: We'll deal with the rest of your display as we go along.
tut_comm_107: First things first - let's get that BattleMech moving!
tut_comm_108: A BattleMech drives like a tank. The 'Mech goes where the legs are pointing, not where you're looking.
tut_comm_109: Ignore that fact and you'll find yourself jammed up wondering why you're not moving.
tut_comm_110: Now since you're a raw recruit, you get extra help to show where your legs are pointing.
tut_comm_111: Look Down. That arrow shows where your legs are pointing. The 'Mech will move in that direction.
tut_comm_112: That's the same arrow that appears on the mini-map.
tut_comm_114: Not out to the side... Use your minimap to figure out where you're pointing.
tut_comm_115: Will you look at that, you're jammed up and wondering why you're not moving.
tut_comm_116: There it is! You found it. That arrow points forward for the 'Mech - no matter where you're looking.
tut_comm_117: No, no.. Down, not up... Change your mouse controls in SETTINGS.
tut_comm_118: Yes, you're a little cramped for space... you're training to be a pilot are yea not? Well get on with it!
tut_comm_125: There's no strafing or sidestepping in a BattleMech - you've got to turn to change direction.
tut_comm_126: Well, off you go. Don't scratch the paint.
tut_comm_127: This brings your view over around on top of your legs and your direction of travel.
tut_comm_128: This shifts your legs so they line up with where you're looking.
tut_comm_129: Look a little more to the side before trying to center your torso or legs so you can better see how the 'Mech reacts.
tut_comm_130: That’s it!  That’s basically how to control all BattleMechs.
tut_comm_131: The throttle meter will tell you how fast you're going.
tut_comm_132: Every BattleMech has different limits to speed and turn rate.
tut_comm_133: Looks like you're jammed up against something, turn your legs - no side strafing here!
tut_comm_134: Remember: Drives like a tank - where are your legs pointed?
tut_comm_135: Some are faster, some are slower and more heavily armored - and some have jump jets to help you get around.
tut_comm_136: You'll have to experiment to find one that fits your style and temperament.
tut_comm_149: And now.... Let's look at your weapons..
tut_comm_150: BattleMechs can be configured in hundreds of ways with dozens of different weapon combinations.
tut_comm_151: The status of each of your weapons is displayed in the lower right of your HUD.
tut_comm_152: Mechs can be equipped with a variety of energy, ballistic and missile weapons.
tut_comm_153: Weapons are clustered into groups that fire together when triggered.
tut_comm_154: I'll just enable your weapons, and off you go!
tut_comm_155: All weapons have a cooldown time, and won't re-fire immediately.
tut_comm_156: Don't be so impatient, there's important stuff to know here!
tut_comm_157: That's your Autocannon: A ballistic weapon.
tut_comm_158: Ballistic weapons run cool and have higher rates of fire, but they can run out of ammo.
tut_comm_159: Ballistic weapons run cooler and have higher rates of fire compared to everything else, but they can run out of ammo.
tut_comm_160: Energy weapons can't run out of ammo, but they do run hot.
tut_comm_162: Every weapon generates heat, too much heat and you'll shut down, keep an eye on your heat meter.
tut_comm_164: Heat limits the damage you do in a Battle.
tut_comm_165: These weapons are set to chainfire - hold down the button to fire everything one after another - this keeps the heat down.
tut_comm_166: Chainfire weapons will also fire as fast as you can click the button. Be careful about over-heating.
tut_comm_167: Try shooting your large laser as you move your controls around.
tut_comm_168: The extra reticle shows where your arms are aiming.
tut_comm_169: That group fires both your arms.
tut_comm_170: Your arms are now unlocked and can move freely.
tut_comm_171: This group fires just the weapon mounted on the 'Mech's torso.
tut_comm_172: An Alpha Strike fires all weapons at once. Expect a lot of heat.
tut_comm_173: Be careful, you're overheating from all that weapon fire - fill your heat meter up and your 'Mech will shut down completely.
tut_comm_174: Ballistics and Missiles Launchers have limited ammo. Check your weapon display.
tut_comm_175: Missile Launchers are usually light and compact for their firepower, but tend to spread their damage.
tut_comm_176: That's a large laser mounted on your right arm.
tut_comm_177: That's a PPC, a Particle Projector Cannon.
tut_comm_178: Medium lasers have moderate range, moderate damage.
tut_comm_179: Large lasers have lots of range, do lots of damage, and generate lots of heat. Heavy and expensive too!
tut_comm_182: Weapons mounted on your arms can aim independently of other weapons - Hold Left-Shift to unlock your arms.
tut_comm_184: Go on! Blow some stuff up!
tut_comm_186: Leave those mechanics alone! They keep these BattleMechs running!
tut_comm_187: Sorry, control over weapon groups have been disabled for the moment.
tut_comm_188: Oh well, You've overheated and shut down - now you'll have to wait for everything to cool off for a few moments before you can do anything.
tut_comm_189: Well congratulations. I'm thoroughly convinced that, with minimal help, you seem to be fully capable of finding your own shiny brass backside.
tut_comm_190: Energy weapons generate a lot of heat.
tut_comm_191: Not much to it is there?
tut_comm_192: Every BattleMech has a different set of weapons it can mount.
tut_comm_193: Once you own your own BattleMech, you can configure it however you want.
tut_comm_194: Now wiggle your controls around fire your arm lasers.
tut_comm_195: This give you extra range and speed.
tut_comm_196: And... when you overheat, you take damage.
tut_comm_197: Those are small lasers - they recharge quickly..
tut_comm_198: Ultimately, heat limits how much damage you do. Watch your temp gauge and learn how much heat each weapon generates.
tut_comm_200: Now, if you're not happy with how the weapons are grouped, or what control they're assigned to.
tut_comm_201: you can change them any time you like from here on in. Even during battle.
tut_comm_204: Press and Hold [F1] at any time if you need a reminder of what button does what. Try it now.
tut_comm_205: Nawww hold it down... like you mean it!
tut_comm_206: You're not a great one for following orders are yea?
tut_comm_207: Now you know where to look, don't forget it's there. Use it!
tut_comm_208: Your go to reference for everything is [ESC].
tut_comm_209: Hit [ESC] again to get back in control of your BattleMech.
tut_comm_210: Here you've got buttons for game settings and such, but you can also click on HUD elements to display a field manual entry.
tut_comm_211: Here you've got buttons for game settings and such, but you can mouse over HUD elements to display a field manual entry.
tut_comm_212: You can also change all the game settings, or exit the level or the game itself using the buttons in the lower left corner.
tut_comm_213: Now you have the tools to figure out how to customize your weapon groups, but let's leave that be for the moment.
tut_comm_214: Now that one tells you how to alter your weapon groups.
tut_comm_215: So that's a complicated HUD your looking at,  and that's why we're giving you access to a field manual - Just hit [ESC].
tut_comm_216: For access to a quick reference for all your controls - hit F1.
tut_comm_217: Click away at the display to pop up more information.
tut_comm_218: To help you learn the controls, your 'Mech comes equipped with a cheat sheet.
tut_comm_219: Have a look around your cockpit, and when you're ready - power-up your BattleMech.
tut_comm_250: Next up: Your BattleGrid mini-map and compass.
tut_comm_251: For this next bit, you'll need to be in your cockpit.
tut_comm_253: That's your compass flashing up there.
tut_comm_255: Make your way out of the landing zone to the next stage.
tut_comm_256: That's a waypoint, the blue smoke and :moveorder: symbol marks it as an objective to go to.
tut_comm_257: That symbol :moveorder: appears on your compass and BattleGrid mini-map.
tut_comm_258: If you switch to the cockpit view, you'll have the BattleGrid to help you navigate your way to the objective.
tut_comm_259: Off you go, Work your way over there and run through the smoke. Don't get lost.
tut_comm_260: Ok, you know the waypoint is a waaaay over there, don't you?
tut_comm_261: You're heading in the wrong direction. Use the BattleGrid map to figure out which way to go.
tut_comm_262: The icon also appears on the compass when you're pointed in roughly the right direction.
tut_comm_263: Well, off you go. Wake me up when you want to carry on.
tut_comm_264: Are you wishing you could start over?
tut_comm_265: Alright, there you go - back to where you started.
tut_comm_267: Pop up the main map to get the lay 'o the land.
tut_comm_268: You can also switch to the Battle Camera and get a better look at your legs.
tut_comm_269: This is your main BattleGrid Map.
tut_comm_270: The BattleGrid is a MechWarriorâ€™s key to strategic planning and execution.
tut_comm_271: You're marked as a little yellow arrowhead - the waypoint has it's own icon.
tut_comm_273: On this 'Mech, your medium and small lasers are mounted on the torso and always fire straight ahead.
tut_comm_274: Small lasers have limited range but can do a lot of damage up close..
tut_comm_300: Right! You made it. Now let's see how well you drive that BattleMech.
tut_comm_301: Start the challenge by going through the green start marker.
tut_comm_303: And make your way through each yellow marker as fast as you can, before the clock runs out.
tut_comm_304: Green smoke marks the finish line.
tut_comm_308: Ach, for the love of... Look at your compass and map, that's what they're for!
tut_comm_309: Almost there, just the finish ahead.
tut_comm_310: Do well to earn rewards that will bring you closer to buying your very own BattleMech.
tut_comm_316: Oh... my grandmum did better than that...
tut_comm_317: Don't worry, you can try again if you wish. Or not - your choice.
tut_comm_318: Better back up and swing your legs around.
tut_comm_321: Not bad. Bronze is better than most first-timers.
tut_comm_323: Well, it's fair to say you could have done better. But no matter - you can retry right now, or at any time later on.
tut_comm_324: Congrats Recruit, you made it through! So let's see what's next on the agenda.
tut_comm_350: See those pillars of light? They mark the starting point for an Academy Challenge.
tut_comm_351: That one reruns the Pilot Challenge for a chance to earn any awards you missed.
tut_comm_352: That one leads on to the next stage - Basic Targeting.
tut_comm_354: You can also jump to a new challenge at any time, hit [ESC] and double-click an entry from the Command and Control Panel.
tut_comm_400: So let's get you dealing with the enemy.
tut_comm_401: One of the most important skills to master is targeting.
tut_comm_402: Enemies appear as red arrowheads on the map and as red diamonds on the compass.
tut_comm_403: Friendly forces appear in blue. That's me on your map.
tut_comm_404: Don't shoot your team mates, it does damage - and they may shoot back!
tut_comm_406: This is the enemy damage indicator. When you target a 'Mech, you get full scan of its weapons and health, front and back.
tut_comm_407: Each part of a BattleMech has separate health and armor.
tut_comm_408: Gold is full health, orange is damaged, and red means dangerously low and about to go.
tut_comm_409: One way to kill a 'Mech is by destroying its center torso.
tut_comm_410: A BattleMech can also be taken out by destroying both legs.
tut_comm_411: And that's to destroy the small vulnerable window protecting the cockpit.
tut_comm_412: On 'Mechs with XL engines, a side torso will also kill the 'Mech.
tut_comm_413: Clan XL engines are tougher, both sides must be destroyed.
tut_comm_414: Enemy 'Mechs need to be in line-of-sight to show up on your radar, so keep a wary eye out.
tut_comm_415: Always check your damage indicator! The center torso on this one is ready to blow. One shot may do it!
tut_comm_416: Check your damage indicator! A leg is gone and the other is ready to blow! One shot may do it!
tut_comm_417: And by a great grand coincidence, this one has one leg gone - shoot the other to finish it off.
tut_comm_418: This one's cored - just shoot it in the chest.
tut_comm_419: Stop playing with it - shoot the leg!
tut_comm_420: Stop playing with it - shoot the chest!
tut_comm_421: Bigger 'Mechs have more armor and health - it can take quite a while to get through it all.
tut_comm_422: That's the way! But be careful - there's another BattleMech behind you. Anything out of view won't show up on your map.
tut_comm_424: Targets farther away take longer to scan.
tut_comm_425: The damage indicator will show you the best place to shoot.
tut_comm_426: That's all there is to it. Target - find the weak spot - kill.  Of course these ones aren't shooting back!
tut_comm_427: Now here's a few more for you to practice on.
tut_comm_428: One arm's already gone on this one!
tut_comm_429: One leg is gone - go for the other one!
tut_comm_430: The armor on the cockpit is gone, but the vulnerable spot on most BattleMechs is quite small.
tut_comm_431: You can zoom in to get a better view.
tut_comm_432: That one's hiding in the smoke. Try thermal vision to cut through the haze.
tut_comm_433: Only your large laser will do damage at this distance.
tut_comm_436: There's one off to the side you've missed.
tut_comm_438: Take off an arm, and the weapons go with it.
tut_comm_439: Target first. Or you won't know what's best to shoot at.
tut_comm_440: That's the way you do it! Find the weakest spot.
tut_comm_441: Congrats, that's tough to do - the cockpit is a small target.
tut_comm_443: You don't need to move about for this.
tut_comm_444: Well, you've run out of ammo for that weapon.
tut_comm_445: Overheating leaves you vulnerable - not a good idea to do in a fight.
tut_comm_450: Hit the targeting key again to switch between available targets.
tut_comm_451: Medium lasers are no damn good at that range. But your large laser will do the trick.
tut_comm_452: That's too far for medium lasers to do any damage.
tut_comm_453: Take a closer look at the center reticle - it turns red when you hit your target.
tut_comm_454: Any damage you do shows up on the display - so you can tell where you hit.
tut_comm_455: That's a big Assault 'Mech - it will take a long time to destroy if you don't target the already damaged components.
tut_comm_456: Well, you killed that one without targeting it. Lucky shot.
tut_comm_457: So, you do realize that there's a faster way? Use the damage panel!
tut_comm_458: Arms are about gone on this one. You still have to take out the center torso, or legs or head.
tut_comm_459: There's less armor and less protection on the back of a BattleMech.
tut_comm_460: Thermal vision can help spot targets a long way off.
tut_comm_461: That one doesn't count, you have to target them first.
tut_comm_462: That's a Light BattleMech - they're fast but easier to kill.
tut_comm_463: Can't find the targeting key? Or just going through the motions?
tut_comm_464: Ach, you're one of those. Very well - move along. I'm sure you're going to be a great asset to any team you join.
tut_comm_465: If you don't target, the kills don't count. It's as simple as that.
tut_comm_466: If you really like doing this, you can just go again once you reach the Academy.
tut_comm_467: You know this is just a simulation don't yea? I can keep spawning these all day!
tut_comm_469: Listen closely, there's another, much harder way to take out a BattleMech.
tut_comm_470: Get up close and see which window protects the cockpit.
tut_comm_471: The cockpit is a very small part of the head. Miss... your shot just hits the torso.
tut_comm_472: The armor on the head is gone, the cockpit is exposed and vulnerable.
tut_comm_473: Two down, one to go. Find the last enemy BattleMech.
tut_comm_474: There's very little armor and structure on the cockpit - it doesn't take much to take it out.
tut_comm_498: Well, we're just about done here, but there's way more to learn about piloting a BattleMech.
tut_comm_499: So let's proceed to the exit waypoint and introduce you to the MechWarrior Academy.
tut_comm_500: Congratulations Cadet, you made it through basic training.
tut_comm_501: You've just scratched the surface of what you'll need to know to survive and thrive on the battlefield.
tut_comm_502: For that, we provide a playground to train and test yourself, and your BattleMechs.
tut_comm_504: Test weapons and BattleMechs at the Firing Range.
tut_comm_508: We'll be adding new training from time to time, so be sure to check back in.
tut_comm_510: Now you get another choice: Continue onto the Academy, or exit. Don't worry, you can get back here at any time by selecting the Academy button from the home page.
tut_comm_511: This is simple enough, use targeting to quickly kill your enemies.
tut_comm_512: Ok, there's one last thing to learn.
tut_comm_513: You can shortcut to any event by hitting [ESC] and double-clicking on the appropriate entry in the Roadmap - it will take you right there.
tut_comm_515: That's too far for an AC/10 to do any damage.
tut_comm_516: Shortly after targeting, a detailed scan appears. Targets farther away take longer to scan.
tut_comm_518: Targeting a 'Mech gives you a detailed scan of loadout and damage levels.

ui_FactionPlayFirstView:
Faction Play is a highly-competitive game mode where players fight for control over the territory of the Inner Sphere. Forge a Contract with one of seven invading Clans or one of six Inner Sphere Houses to fight under their banner and earn Faction rewards.

Faction Play has a strong emphasis on team cohesion and specialized 'Mech loadouts, and unlike Quick Play there is no skill-based matchmaking system in place! Faction Play matches are often comprised of experienced and organized MechWarriors running well-stocked and heavily customized 'Mech loadouts. 

If you are new to MechWarrior Online we strongly recommend honing your skills in Quick Play and building up a stock of at least four customized and familiar 'Mechs before joining the fight for the Inner Sphere.

davion_long_history:
The largest of the successor states, the Federated Suns is often considered the preeminent military power in the Inner Sphere. Davion society is fixated on martial prowess and has a reputation for being hawkish and bellicose.

Strongly influenced by pre-first exodus Great Britain, United States and France, it often boasts of its high minded values and civil liberties. Despite these claims it is first-and-foremost a constitutional monarchy, ruled over by the Davion bloodline and various aristocrats.

Much of its territorial expansion over the years have come at the expense of the Capellans creating an ever-lasting animosity with House Liao. An alliance was struck with House Steiner of the Lyran Alliance in the face of similar conflicts with the Draconis Combine and Free Worlds League.
kurita_long_history:
Possessing one of the best trained armies in the Inner Sphere, House Kurita believes it is destined to one day rule over the other Houses and aggressively pursues this end.

Following the ancient tenants of Bushido, Draconis Combine society follows the Five Pillars and values honor, duty and conquest above all else. House Kurita rules their people with complete dictatorial power in the style of feudal Japan on ancient Terra.

Shortly after the collapse of the Star League the Combine conquered the peaceful people of Rasalhague leading to a long and bloody occupation. Kurita's continued hostility to its neighbors drew ire from both the Lyrans and Federated Suns whom established an alliance to combat the machinations of the advancing Draconis forces.
liao_long_history:
Considered a repressive dictatorship by most, the Capellan Confederation's relatively small territory hosts the most loyal and civic minded society in the Inner Sphere.

Ruled over by a Chancellor wielding absolute power, citizenship must be earned with each person evaluated to determine their contributions to the whole. House Liao can trace its traditions back to its strong Chinese and Russian influences.

Much of its size has been diminished after years of successive defeats at the hands of the Federated Suns. It was this constant barrage that led the Capellans to eventually seek out an ally in their former enemy the Free Worlds League and the Draconis Combine.
marik_long_history:
The Free Worlds League has the distinction of being the oldest of the successor states. While its society is multicultural and has historically offered great autonomy to its regions it now exists in a perpetual state of martial law.

Originally a loose alliance between early states of European, American and Indian roots, the League functions as a representative democracy ruled by a parliament. Despite the democratic nature of the government House Marik still wields supreme control over the armed forces and has the final word on most issues.

House Marik was at war with Steiner almost immediately after the fall of the Star League and continued throughout the following wars of succession. Once House Steiner and Davion had declared their alliance the Free Worlds League turned to Kurita and Liao for support re-balancing the forces of the Inner Sphere.
rasalhague_long_history:
The youngest among the successor states, the Free Rasalhague Republic's ultimate goal is simply to survive as a nation amongst the larger warlike Great Houses around them.

The FRR is not ruled by a noble House and is one of a few true democratic states in the Inner Sphere. Due to Rasalhague's location between the Great Houses Steiner and Kurita its Scandinavian background is now intertwined with that of those two nations.

Once an early interplanetary state, Rasalhague was completely absorbed into the Draconis Combine during an invasion centuries ago. Its sovereignty was only recently granted by an agreement between Great Houses Steiner and Kurita. Each ceded control of several planets to Rasalhague whom would act as a buffer state and remain neutral to both parties.
steiner_long_history:
One of the largest successor states, the Lyran Commonwealth is renowned for its unparalleled wealth, advanced industries and complete lack of military cunning.

Ostensibly a hereditary monarchy, House Steiner is largely careful to ensure the rights and freedoms of their people are upheld. It is common for nobility to be gifted high ranking posts in the military leaving the Lyran command structure historically inept, hampering many of their intergalactic ambitions.

The Lyran Commonwealth was eager to capitalize on the chaos after the fall of the Star League and began a push to capture world belonging to the Free Worlds League. They soon found themselves surrounded by enemies as the Draconis Combine initiated their own campaigns against the Commonwealth. It was with this in mind that Steiner and Davion would form an alliance between their two powerful Houses.
smokejaguar_long_history:
Brutal, cunning, and savage, Clan Smoke Jaguar pay only minimal respect to tradition and leave nothing but bloodshed in their wake. As the founders of the Crusader ideology they seek conquest above all other goals.

Smoke Jaguar society is completely subservient to those in the warrior caste. They despise freeborn and hold very little esteem for those outside of the military. Therefore, much of the Jaguars resources and scientific capacity is provided solely from raids on its neighboring Clans.

Jaguar's cruelty and ambition often put them at odds with other Clans. While Wolf remains the key target of their ire, Smoke Jaguar does not always enjoy sharing control of the Crusaders with Jade Falcon and will often look for ways to overshadow their rivals.
jadefalcon_long_history:
Well known for a stubborn adherence to tradition, Clan Jade Falcon is also known for it's arrogance and impulsiveness on the battlefield. Their petulance and Crusader nature make the Falcons a dangerous and unpredictable foe.

Much of the Clan's society is fixated on tradition, genetic purity, and conquest. Advancement and personal pride are of paramount importance in all facets of Jade Falcon life. Their strong will to dominate is often offset by hasty actions that have a habit of costing them victory on the battlefield.

Jade Falcon abhors deviation from tradition and often derides the Warden's vision of Clan conduct. The Falcons have a long standing hatred of Clan Wolf stemming back to their mutual formation when Wolf was appointed the holders of the founder's Bloodname.
wolf_long_history:
Clan Wolf, Leader of the Warden Clans, is known for its deliberate and balanced approach to both society and warfare. Wolf's successes can be attributed to the value they place on collecting intelligence, logistics and seizing opportunities.

Wolf society is much less formal than that of other Clans. Warriors are expected to make political decisions and all their castes tend to receive relatively fair treatment. Wolf is one of the most tolerant of the Clan cultures, openly allowing freeborn to hold prestigious positions within its ranks.

As keepers of the Kerensky Bloodname, Clan Wolf's voice is often heard the loudest amongst the Clans. Sadly this does not shield them from their rivals. Wolf must stay ever vigilant against constant Crusader plots to usurp them.
ghostbear_long_history:
Ghost Bear values Strength, family, and patience above all else. Known for their detailed planning and patience, they are much less likely to rush to battle than other Crusader minded Clans.

Putting special emphasis on training and discipline, the Bears pride themselves on their preparedness and forward thinking tactics. The significance of family and relatively good treatment of freeborn in Ghost Bear society does not conform with usual Crusader attitudes.

While ostensibly a Crusader state, Clan Ghost Bear does not share their tenancy towards hot-headedness, often leading to friction with other Crusaders. The Bears fought against Clan Wolf for the right to launch the invasion of the Inner Sphere but tend to remain more-or-less neutral to most disputes amongst the Clans.

davion_pledge_loyalty_desc: Congratulations from the Department of Mercenary Relations on passing muster for this offer of a long-term contract. Your acumen and sensibilities are an asset that will greatly aid the Federated Commonwealth.
kurita_pledge_loyalty_desc: The Draconis Combine Professional Soldiery Liaison extends you privilege of a long-term contract. Your swords will be first among equals as you guard the borders of our great realm!
liao_pledge_loyalty_desc: You are bestowed the high gift of a Charter you will accept for long-term employment for the greater good of the glorious Capellan Confederation.\n\nCapellan Command Council
marik_pledge_loyalty_desc: The League Central Coordination And Command welcomes your acceptance of a long-term contract with the first Great House. Your reputation and service will be celebrated by the Free Worlds League.
rasalhague_pledge_loyalty_desc: The KungsArmé Mercenary Relations welcomes an acceptance of a long-term contract. As with our short-term contracts, you must adhere to all stipulations.\n\nJoin for freedom.
steiner_pledge_loyalty_desc: The Department of Mercenary Relations offers congratulations on passing muster for this offer of a long-term contract. Your sensibilities and acumen are an asset that will greatly aid the Federated Commonwealth.
smokejaguar_pledge_loyalty_desc: You are saabtakha, adopted to become a warrior of Clan Smoke Jaguar for the specified time frame. Jaguar springs; Jaguar claws; Jaguar tastes: may you emulate the Founder’s favorite totem.
jadefalcon_pledge_loyalty_desc: Embrace the fire of the first Falcon; put on the mantle of stubbornness. You are adopted, saabtakha, into Clan Jade Falcon. Accept the will to remember during your service and you shall fly with us above all others.
wolf_pledge_loyalty_desc: If you accept this adoption, saabtakha, for long-term service with Clan Wolf, you must be ever vigilant. Willing to lope for long miles, silent and patient. Yet strike in an instant when the time arrives for action.
ghostbear_pledge_loyalty_desc: The courage of Tseng; the foresight of Jorgensson. You are saabtakha, adopted into Clan Ghost Bear. Bring these attributes to your long-term service and you will be honored among our warriors.
ui_loyalty_probation_desc: The pledge of loyalty should not be made lightly. The Newly Recruited Loyalist probation period lasts ten invasion matches, during that time you are unable to collect mission payouts or use loyalist-only features.
ui_MercenaryContractUnit_Desc: On behalf of your unit, do you swear to carry out the duties and obligations requested for the length of time stipulated by the contract?
davion_contract_desc: The Department of Mercenary Relations extends a short-term contract for your hire in the defense of the free peoples of the Federated Commonwealth.\n\nField Marshal Grissom Miller
kurita_contract_desc: For the glory of the Dragon, you are honored with a short-term contract under the auspice of the Professional Soldiery Liaison to serve the Combine as needed alongside the Pillar of Steel.
liao_contract_desc: Accept this short-term contract from the Capellan Command Council. Your sellswords will protect the Chancellor and his magnificent Capellan Confederation from his enemies.
marik_contract_desc: Well-met accomplished soldier. The League Central Coordination And Command salutes your bravery in accepting a short-term contract to protect the peoples of the Free World League.
rasalhague_contract_desc: The KungsArmé Mercenary Relations extends a short-term contract. If you accept, you will adhere to all stipulations within the contract for the duration of your employment.\n\nWelcome.
steiner_contract_desc: A short-term contract for your hire is extended by the Department of Mercenary Relations for the defense of the free peoples of the Federated Commonwealth.\n\nField Marshal Grissom Miller
smokejaguar_contract_desc: Accept this bondtroth of short-term service with the Touman of Clan Smoke Jaguar. Khan Lincoln Osis is watching and will mete out justice equal to your courage and prowess.
jadefalcon_contract_desc: Elias Crichell, Khan of Clan Jade Falcon, guardians of the Founder’s vision, offers you bondtroth of short-term service. The eyes of the Falcon are ever upon your battles.
wolf_contract_desc: Accept this bondtroth for short-term service in the Clan the Founder chose to mingle his blood. Khan Ulric Kerensky patiently awaits the record you will forge on future fields of battle.
ghostbear_contract_desc: By the hand of Bjorn Jorgensson, accept this bondtroth for short-term service with Clan Ghost Bear. May the ursus within arise as needed: for protection, for attack, for the family.

CR_AD_I_Clan_Ghost_Bear: Such a debacle as this failed assault mocks the might of the bear. Khan Bjorn Jorgensson feels spurned after accepting your service, as do all warriors of the Clan Ghost Bear Touman. Accept again our embrace and the skills we offer and ensure victory for the family.
CR_AD_I_Clan_Jade_Falcon: Freebirth! You sully the mighty Clan Jade Falcon—the Founder’s dream incarnate—with your lackluster skills. Your assault was in shambles before the attack even began. You failed to grasp our nathaculor—the strike of the unswerving sword. Failure to heed Falcon tactics in the future will end in your misery.
CR_AD_I_Clan_Smoke_Jaguar: Savashri! First year sibkin can execute a better assault than your travesty of a deployment. Your enemies rejoice at your defeat. Spurn your blood. Mock Clan Smoke Jaguar. Khan Lincoln Osis will not accept weakness in any warriors, especially you. Seize the next victory, or you will be forgotten.
CR_AD_I_Clan_Wolf: Khan Ulric Kerensky is disappointed in your failed assault. Bowing to the pressure of chaos and the fog of war that engulfs any battlefield. Your previous acuity, none-the-less, shows your skills remain true, though untapped for this battle. Seize upon your past victories to emulate them for the future.
CR_AD_I_IS_Davion: The nature of your failed assault leads us to question your competency. Intel is pouring over the battleroms from your attack. We strongly urge a review of said footage and implementing necessary changes to ensure success in the future.
CR_AD_I_IS_Kurita: The lack of discipline and battlefield awareness displayed in your failed assault is a stain upon your reputation and honor.
CR_AD_I_IS_Liao: Inbred! Servitors would demonstrate greater acumen in an assault than your clumsy attempts at battle tactics. You shall lead the next assault and the results must be a victory or prepare for the consequences.
CR_AD_I_IS_Rasalhague: We express deep—though unsurprised—disappointment at your lackluster assault. That you failed to achieve what our warriors accomplished while beset on all sides and under the aegis of a newly free nation…pray you are able to prove your abilities in future battles.
CR_AD_I_IS_Marik: The League Central Coordination And Command postulates a need to review operational parameters due to your latest failed assault. Such a review will uncover compromising elements and allow you to ensure victory for the next assignment. While disappointed, we are confident in your future success.
CR_AD_I_IS_Steiner: While Intel is pouring over the battleroms from your attack, the nature of your failed assault leads us to question your abilities. We strongly urge a review of your own orders and implement necessary changes to ensure success in the future.
CR_AV_I_Clan_Ghost_Bear: Ursus roars at your brilliant assault, warrior. The mighty ghost bear acknowledges battle acumen, regardless of its source. Your family in Clan Ghost Bear rejoice at your success and embrace the honor you bring. Long may the foresight of Jorgensson be found in your victories to come.
CR_AV_I_Clan_Jade_Falcon: Your brilliant assault is a testament to your skills and honors the blood that flows in your veins. Turkina’s eyes shine bright; her claws tear fresh; her wings fly high for you this day, warrior. The Founder’s vision sees an echo in your battlefield prowess. Long may your shadow join the Falcon’s wings.
CR_AV_I_Clan_Smoke_Jaguar: Glory to you warrior for your triumphant assault! Your prowess matches the smoke jaguar, whom you emulate with claw and spring and blood. The Touman watches and grins the bared teeth of victory. You honor your blood this day…long may you be remembered for your service this day.
CR_AV_I_Clan_Wolf: Though freeborn, your blood sings true, trothkin. Your magnificent assault was filled with all the rage and fury of the best Wolf warriors. Yet tempered with the knowledge of when to relent, when to feint, and when to seize victory despite apparent defeat. A skill other Clan’s warriors sorely lack.
CR_AV_I_IS_Davion: Congratulations on your victory. Your tactics during the initial attack were particularly effective and will be studied at great depth in acknowledgement of your skill and prowess under adverse conditions. This is a testament to your battle acumen.
CR_AV_I_IS_Kurita: Honor to you, for your glorious assault. The warriors of the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery salute your attack and recognize a warrior worthy of respect. May the sun never set upon your battlefield acuity, nor your unflinching bravery to expand the might of the Dragon.
CR_AV_I_IS_Liao: Under the Celestial Wisdom’s hand your assault was foreordained for victory! A testament to your skills. Long will your victories under the Chancellor’s hands be celebrated.
CR_AV_I_IS_Rasalhague: The proof of your loyalty in successfully executing your assault is welcomed. If more of your brethren demonstrate such professionalism in their service, the citizens of the Free Rasalhague Republic may yet change their perspectives concerning your value. Well done.
CR_AV_I_IS_Marik: Your victory in the assault is a triumph for all the peoples of the Free Worlds League. The League Central Coordination And Command commends your skill and dedication.
CR_AV_I_IS_Steiner: Congratulations! Your victory is a testament to your battle acumen, and instills confidence in your abilities. Your tactics during the initial attack were particularly effective and will be studied at great depth in acknowledgement of your skill and prowess under adverse conditions.
CR_DD_I_Clan_Ghost_Bear: There is no greater shame, warrior. You spilled the blood of the family in your travesty of a defense. The great ghost bear is slow to move, yet when that moment arrives, erupts with terrible fury. Ensure your future defenses protect Clan Ghost Bear lest we bring that fury against you.
CR_DD_I_Clan_Jade_Falcon: Our enemies have poisoned Clan Jade Falcon soil with their presence, all due to your ineptitude! Fledgling warriors fresh into an Eyrie Cluster demonstrate greater acumen than you have today. Your failed defense is a stain on your blood you will long work to cleanse. Khan Elias Crichell is watching, and is most displeased with your service.
CR_DD_I_Clan_Smoke_Jaguar: You belittle the oaths you have taken in your failed defense. Solahma warriors ragged with their last breath in age show more spirit. Pray you are not called out in a Circle of Equals for your failure; as surely as The Founder forged the Clans you would be destroyed. Victory next time, warrior!
CR_DD_I_Clan_Wolf: Wolf blood was spilled this day in your disastrous defense. Blood that calls for vengeance. But the Wolf does not cull from the pack in the heat of battle. Your history marks you as a warrior worthy of your service with our Clan. Remember that and seize victory on another day and the clamor for vengeance with slack.
CR_DD_I_IS_Davion: Your failed defense leaves much to be desired and calls your abilities into question. After all, when the peoples of the Federated Commonwealth feel the sting of enemies grounding on their worlds, it cannot but elicit such a reaction. In the strongest terms we suggest a reassessment of your battle strategies.
CR_DD_I_IS_Kurita: The blood of the Dragon was spilt this day in your abysmal defense. The cries of the innocent mock your honor and astuteness on the field of battle. Allowing our enemies one meter of ground is unacceptable. Future defenses must erase your stain, or risk a permanent black mark on your honor.
CR_DD_I_IS_Liao: Swine! Your defeat at the hands of the Celestial Wisdom’s enemies is a disgrace. Capellan children would defend their homeland with more dedication and skill than your failed defense.
CR_DD_I_IS_Rasalhague: This is an outrage and the Free Rasalhague Republic citizens deserve better. Your botched defense mirrors a long line of failures of your so-called ‘professional’ soldier brethren. You will keep all personnel on reservation between deployments and your next defense will be a success.
CR_DD_I_IS_Marik: Your failed defense has left peoples of the Free Worlds League in harms way. The League Central Coordination And Command condemns your botched service and urges—in the strongest terms possible—a reevaluation of your combat doctrine to ensure future defenses will result in victory.
CR_DD_I_IS_Steiner: When the peoples of the Federated Commonwealth feel the sting of enemies grounding on their worlds, it cannot but elicit a strong reaction. Your failed defense leaves much to be desired, and calls your abilities into question. We suggest in the strongest terms a reassessment of your battle strategies.
CR_DV_I_Clan_Ghost_Bear: There is no greater glory than protecting the family. Your exemplar defense of Clan Ghost Bear holdings heralds your ristar status loud and clear. You are a warrior to be watched; a warrior to be tested; a warrior to fight alongside. You reflect back to our own Clansmen the courage of Tseng. Seyla.
CR_DV_I_Clan_Jade_Falcon: Well bargained and done, warrior. You superbly orchestrated your cutdown, selected your battlefield, and executed a defense that sent your opponent fleeing in shame. The warriors of the Clan Jade Falcon Touman salute you for your prowess and the ease with which you let all enemies know of Falcon strength.
CR_DV_I_Clan_Smoke_Jaguar: Seyla. Your brilliant defense of Clan Smoke Jaguar holdings is worthy of praise. You do your blood honor as the skills you espouse showcase your battlefield worthiness to fight alongside the warriors of our Touman. You may yet earn a line in The Remembrance for your great deeds this day.
CR_DV_I_Clan_Wolf: The best defense is a better offense. A saying spoken by many, but few can execute. Honor to you trothkin, for a victorious defense that emulates the best of Clan tactics. The warriors of the Clan Wolf Touman howl in your honor this day as you let all Clansmen know not all of the best warriors are trueborn.
CR_DV_I_IS_Davion: The tactics and strategies employed were exceptionally effective! The peoples of the Federated Commonwealth extend their heart-felt thanks for your successful defense.
CR_DV_I_IS_Kurita: A staunch defense worthy of a haiku. The Professional Soldiery Liaison recognizes your exceptional service in defending the realm against enemies jealous of the Dragon’s might and majesty. May your blade always shine and your honor never fade as you continue in our service.
CR_DV_I_IS_Liao: The prudence of the Celestial Wisdom shines forth in bringing your skills to the bulwark of the empire. Your intuitive defense saved Capellan blood and vaulted your name in reputation across the Inner Sphere. Continue such feats and you may receive a direct visit from his blessed personage!
CR_DV_I_IS_Rasalhague: We are surprisingly pleased at your effective defense of the citizens of the Free Rasalhague Republic. Your skill and dedication to the Republic are traits to be emulated. May you continue such exemplary performance in all future battles.
CR_DV_I_IS_Marik: Your spirited defense of the peoples of the Free Worlds League will be heralded from world to world as news of your victory spreads.  The League Central Coordination And Command congratulates you for your valiant efforts in protecting the borders of the first Great House.
CR_DV_I_IS_Steiner: The peoples of the Federated Commonwealth extends their heart-felt thanks for your successful defense! The tactics and strategies employed were exceptionally effective and reinforce the truth of your abilities.
CR_S_AD_Clan_Ghost_Bear: Those whom saw you swear your oath also bore witness to your failed attempt to scout the enemy. Khan Bjorn Jorgensson feels spurned after accepting your service, as do all warriors of the Clan Ghost Bear Touman. Accept again our embrace and the skills we offer and ensure victory for the family.
CR_S_AD_Clan_Jade_Falcon: Freebirth! You sully the mighty Clan Jade Falcon—the Founder’s dream incarnate—with your lackluster skills. The failed outcome of your scouting mission was unbefitting a warrior under the wing of the falcon. You failed to grasp our nathaculor—the strike of the unswerving sword. Failure to heed Falcon tactics in the future will end in your misery.
CR_S_AD_Clan_Smoke_Jaguar: Savashri! You failed to silently stalk like the jaguar, thus your scouting team found only failure. Your enemies rejoice at your defeat. Spurn your blood. Mock Clan Smoke Jaguar. Khan Lincoln Osis will not accept weakness in any warriors, especially you. Seize the next victory, or you will be forgotten.
CR_S_AD_Clan_Wolf: Khan Ulric Kerensky is disappointed in your failed reconnaissance mission. You lacked awareness of the enemy and disregarded the teachings of the Wolf. Your previous acuity, none-the-less, shows your skills remain true, though untapped for this battle. Seize upon your past victories to emulate them for the future.
CR_S_AD_IS_Davion: The nature of your failed scouting mission leads us to question your abilities. Your probing rendered us little useful intel beyond the video battle logs of your failure. We strongly urge a review of said footage and implementing necessary changes to ensure success in the future.
CR_S_AD_IS_Kurita: Your lack of discipline and awareness during the scouting mission has cost us valuable information.
CR_S_AD_IS_Liao: Servitors would demonstrate greater acumen scouting behind enemy lines than you and your team. If you are to lead another mission, find victory or face the consequences.
CR_S_AD_IS_Rasalhague: We express deep—though unsurprised—disappointment at the lack of information provided by your scouting mission. That you failed to achieve what our warriors accomplished while beset on all sides and under the aegis of a newly free nation…pray you are able to prove your abilities in future battles.
CR_S_AD_IS_Marik: The League Central Coordination And Command will begin a full review of the failed scouting mission. Such a review will uncover compromising elements and allow you to ensure victory for the next assignment. While disappointed, we are confident in your future success.
CR_S_AD_IS_Steiner: Little to no intel was recovered and the nature of your failed scouting objective leaves us questioning your abilities. We strongly urge a review of your own orders and implement necessary changes to ensure success in the future.
CR_S_AV_Clan_Ghost_Bear: Ursus roars at your brilliant tactics while scouting, warrior. The mighty ghost bear acknowledges battle acumen, regardless of its source. Your family in Clan Ghost Bear rejoice at your success and embrace the honor you bring. Long may the foresight of Jorgensson be found in your victories to come.
CR_S_AV_Clan_Jade_Falcon: Your brilliant scouting mission is a testament to the intellect, prowess, and blood that flows in your veins. Turkina’s eyes shine bright; her claws tear fresh; her wings fly high for you this day, warrior. The Founder’s vision sees an echo in your cunning. Long may your shadow join the Falcon’s wings.
CR_S_AV_Clan_Smoke_Jaguar: Glory to you and your courageous scouting party! Your prowess matches the smoke jaguar, whom you emulate with claw and spring and blood. The Touman watches and grins the bared teeth of victory. You honor your blood this day…long may you be remembered for your service this day.
CR_S_AV_Clan_Wolf: Though freeborn, your blood sings true, trothkin. Your successful scouting mission was tempered with the knowledge of when to relent, when to feint, and when to seize victory despite apparent defeat. A skill other Clan’s warriors sorely lack.
CR_S_AV_IS_Davion: Congratulations on your victory. Your tactics during the scouting mission were particularly effective and will be studied at great depth in acknowledgement of your skill and prowess under adverse conditions. This is a testament to your battle acumen.
CR_S_AV_IS_Kurita: Honor to you, for the intel you recovered while scouting. The warriors of the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery salute your skills and recognize a warrior worthy of respect. May the sun never set upon your battlefield acuity, nor your unflinching bravery to expand the might of the Dragon.
CR_S_AV_IS_Liao: Under the Celestial Wisdom’s hand your scouting mission was foreordained for victory! Long will your victories under the Chancellor’s hands be celebrated.
CR_S_AV_IS_Rasalhague: The proof of your loyalty in successfully executing your scouting raid is welcomed. If more of your brethren demonstrate such professionalism in their service, the citizens of the Free Rasalhague Republic may yet change their perspectives concerning your value. Well done.
CR_S_AV_IS_Marik: Your victory in the scouting raid is a triumph for all the peoples of the Free Worlds League. The League Central Coordination And Command commends your skill and dedication.
CR_S_AV_IS_Steiner: Congratulations on your victory. Your tactics during the scouting mission were particularly effective and will be studied at great depth in acknowledgement of your skill and prowess behind enemy lines. This is all a testament to your battle acumen and further reminds us of your abilities.
CR_S_DD_Clan_Ghost_Bear: There is no greater shame, warrior. You spilled the blood of the family in your travesty of a defense. The great ghost bear is slow to move, yet when that moment arrives, erupts with terrible fury. Ensure your future defenses protect Clan Ghost Bear lest we bring that fury against you.
CR_S_DD_Clan_Jade_Falcon: Our enemies have poisoned Clan Jade Falcon soil with their mere presence, all due to your ineptitude! Fledgling warriors fresh into an Eyrie Cluster demonstrate greater acumen than you have today. Your failed defense is a stain on your blood you will long work to cleanse. Khan Elias Crichell is watching, and is most displeased with your service.
CR_S_DD_Clan_Smoke_Jaguar: You belittle the oaths you have taken in your failed defense against a simple scouting party. Solahma warriors ragged with their last breath in age show more spirit. Pray you are not called out in a Circle of Equals for your failure; as surely as The Founder forged the Clans you would be destroyed. Victory next time, warrior!
CR_S_DD_Clan_Wolf: Wolf blood was spilled this day in your disastrous defense. Blood that calls for vengeance. But the Wolf does not cull from the pack in the heat of battle. Your history marks you as a warrior worthy of your service with our Clan. Remember that and seize victory on another day and the clamor for vengeance with slack.
CR_S_DD_IS_Davion: Your failed defense leaves much to be desired and calls into question your abilities as a warrior. After all, when the peoples of the Federated Commonwealth feel the sting of enemies behind their lines, it cannot but elicit such a reaction. In the strongest terms we suggest a reassessment of your battle strategies.
CR_S_DD_IS_Kurita: Vital data was lost this day in your abysmal defense. The cries of the innocent mock your honor and astuteness on the field of battle. Allowing our enemies success into our computer systems is unacceptable. Future defenses must erase your stain, or risk a permanent black mark on your honor.
CR_S_DD_IS_Liao: Swine! Your defeat at the hands of the Celestial Wisdom’s enemies is a disgrace. Capellan children would defend their homeland with more dedication and skill than your failed defense of our data networks.
CR_S_DD_IS_Rasalhague: This is an outrage and the Free Rasalhague Republic citizens deserve better. Your botched defense mirrors a long line of failures of your so-called ‘professional’ soldier brethren. You will keep all personnel on reservation between deployments and your next defense will be a success.
CR_S_DD_IS_Marik: Your failed defense has left peoples of the Free Worlds League in harms way. The League Central Coordination And Command condemns your botched service and urges—in the strongest terms possible—a reevaluation of your combat doctrine to ensure future defenses will result in victory.
CR_S_DD_IS_Steiner: Your failed defense leaves much to be desired and calls into question the true depth of your abilities. After all, when the peoples of the Federated Commonwealth feel the sting of enemies behind their lines, it cannot but elicit such a reaction. In the strongest terms we suggest a reassessment of your battle strategies.
CR_S_DV_Clan_Ghost_Bear: There is no greater glory than protecting the family. Your exemplar defense of Clan Ghost Bear holdings heralds your ristar status loud and clear. You are a warrior to be watched; a warrior to be tested; a warrior to fight alongside. You reflect back to our own Clansmen the courage of Tseng. Seyla.
CR_S_DV_Clan_Jade_Falcon: Well bargained and done, warrior. You superbly executed a defense that sent your opponent fleeing in shame. The warriors of the Clan Jade Falcon Touman salute you for your prowess and the ease with which you let all enemies know of Falcon strength.
CR_S_DV_Clan_Smoke_Jaguar: Seyla. Your brilliant defense of Clan Smoke Jaguar holdings is worthy of praise. You do your blood honor as the skills you espouse showcase your battlefield worthiness to defend our most vital territory. You may yet earn a line in The Remembrance for your great deeds this day.
CR_S_DV_Clan_Wolf: The best defense is a better offense. A saying spoken by many, but few can execute. Honor to you trothkin, for a victorious defense that emulates the best of Clan tactics. The warriors of the Clan Wolf Touman howl in your honor this day as you let all Clansmen know not all of the best warriors are trueborn.
CR_S_DV_IS_Davion: The tactics and strategies employed were exceptionally effective! The peoples of the Federated Commonwealth extend their heart-felt thanks for your successful defense.
CR_S_DV_IS_Kurita: A staunch defense worthy of a haiku. The Professional Soldiery Liaison recognizes your exceptional service in defending our base against enemies jealous of the Dragon’s might and majesty. May your blade always shine and your honor never fade as you continue in our service.
CR_S_DV_IS_Liao: The prudence of the Celestial Wisdom shines forth in bringing your skills to the bulwark of the empire. Your intuitive defense saved Capellan blood and vaulted your name in reputation across the Inner Sphere. Continue such feats and you may receive a direct visit from his blessed personage!
CR_S_DV_IS_Rasalhague: We are surprisingly pleased at your effective defense of the information in our networks. Your skill and dedication to the Republic are traits to be emulated. May you continue such exemplary performance in all future battles.
CR_S_DV_IS_Marik: Your spirited defense of the peoples of the Free Worlds League will be heralded from world to world as news of your victory spreads. The League Central Coordination And Command congratulates you for your valiant efforts in protecting the borders of the first Great House.
CR_S_DV_IS_Steiner: The tactics and strategies employed were exceptionally effective! The peoples of the Federated Commonwealth extend to you heart-felt thanks for your successful defense!

ui_DropDeckDescription:
A Drop Deck is required for participating in Faction Play matches, and must meet the following conditions:

• The chosen 'Mechs must be compatible with your given Contract. For example, you cannot use a Clan 'Mech in your Drop Deck if you are aligned with an Inner Sphere Faction
 • Your Drop Deck must be comprised of four 'Mechs (1 for Scouting)
 • The combined tonnage of your four chosen ‘Mechs must fall within the current Tonnage restrictions.

ui_FactionWarefare_Desc: Faction Play is where highly-competitive MechWarriors fight for control over the Inner Sphere through distinct game modes. It places a strong emphasis on team cohesion and specialized 'Mech loadouts. Faction Play matches are thus often comprised of experienced and well-organized Units of players running heavily customized 'Mechs.\n\nWhether you choose to forge a temporary Contract as a Mercenary, pledge allegiance as a Loyalist, or act as a Freelancer under no consistent banner, you will band together with other players to shift the balance of power and conquer the Inner Sphere.
ui_FreelancerRoleDescription:
The Freelancer MechWarrior participates in a neutral capacity where C-Bill contracts are the only motivation. Faction loyalty means nothing to them and they focus completely on earning revenue.

While it may seem that these MechWarriors don't matter in the grand scheme of the battle, they are imperative for logistical force enhancement.

Freelancers are essentially the hired guns who crave the thrill of battle. Choosing the Freelancer path provides a slight XP boost for every match played.
ui_MercenaryRoleDescription: Mercenary Units are the core workhorses in a conflict. They bring experienced and organized companies to the battlefield. These forces come at a cost to those who hire them as the all mighty C-Bill is the only source of negotiation.\n\nChoosing the Mercenary path provides a slight C-Bill boost for every match played.
ui_LoyalistRoleDescription: Loyalists bring dedicated forces who will fight to the last combatant standing in order to bring victory and pride to the Faction they are aligned with. In turn, Factions will reward Loyalists with extras that cannot be gained in any other manner.\n\nChoosing the Loyalist path provides Loyalty Points for Loyalist titles and rewards.

CR_AV_Freelancer: Good work. Clients rarely come to us expecting anything more than meat in a tin can to fill out the front-line when they’re on the offensive. With today’s victory you’ve not only bought another day of freedom on your own terms, you’ve strengthened your reputation with a valuable client. When it comes to Freelancing, no payout is worth more than your reputation.
CR_AD_I_Freelancer: Your mission was a failure. They took you on expecting meat for the front-line, and meat is what they got. At least you made it out alive, and there’s value in survival. Just don’t make losing a habit, and you might still get some work.

CR_DD_Freelancer: Your mission was a failure. When a client looks to you for defense they aren’t doing it because they believe in you. They know a Freelancer isn’t going to care about some long-forgotten planet that hasn’t meant something for a hundred years. They come to you because their ranks are thin and they’re up against the wall, taking whatever they can get with the hope they’ll get lucky. From the looks of these results, the only luck out there today went toward getting you out alive and intact. Don’t let that be for nothing.

CR_DV_Freelancer: Outstanding work. It’s not often that a Freelancer can distinguish themselves in a defensive action; the Loyalists and career Mercs are usually fighting each other for glory just as much as they fight the enemy. Make no mistake, that planet stands intact because you met the call to action and made it happen. You’ve more than earned your pay, but before you head off to Solaris and blow it all on a fight I’d recommend you head back down planetside. You won’t find a more ‘welcoming’ populous than one you just saved.

When you were first called to arms they made it clear it was out of necessity; with this defeat your next job may arise only out of desperation. If you continue to engage in losing battles, even the most desperate of prospective clients may hesitate to call upon you at all.
CR_S_AV_Freelancer: The client was pleased with your performance. innersphere_long_history:
From the remnants of the once unified Star League, six Great Houses make up what is known as the Inner Sphere. Each of the Great Houses has ties to different cultures and nations from its Earthbound past. 

A far cry from the prosperity and relative peace of their days in the Star League, the great houses have been embroiled in centuries of endless war and infighting. 

Pressured by the Clan Invasion, the Great Houses must form an uneasy alliance under their shared Inner Sphere banner in order to push back the ceaseless invaders.
clan_long_history: After patiently waiting in the depths of space, the Clans have emerged from the darkness to pounce upon the Inner Sphere. After embarking on a self-imposed exile, the Star League Defense Force, their descendants have emerged in the forms of the Clans. \n\nDriven by generations of genetic alteration and a warlike society, the Clans have transformed themselves into a vicous tribe of warriors. Fueled by their desire to establish their genetic supremacy over the Inner Sphere, the Clans won't stop until they've achieved their ultimate goal.

ui_Ledgerinfo: Welcome to your Skill Tree Refund Ledger! \nWithin this Ledger you'll find a complete, itemized rundown covering the transfer of your existing Skill progress and Skill-related currencies into the new Skill Tree system. \nWe've taken great care to ensure that none of your Skill progress is lost and that your existing Module inventory has been accounted for. You can find explanations for each refund component in the summaries below.
ui_RefundModulesCB_Info: This is the total refund in C-Bills you are receiving for all of the Owned (Non-Consumable) Modules in your Inventory at the time of the May 16th patch (if they were acquired after December 3rd 2016). These Modules are being refunded as C-Bills due to our original intent to provide full C-Bill refunds for all Owned Modules. We understand some players made Module purchasing decisions based on that original statement, so all purchases made after that statement are being refunded as C-Bills.\nThis is a 1:1 refund of the original C-Bill purchase value of your Owned Modules acquired after December 3rd 2016! If applicable you'll also receive purchase value C-Bill 'refunds' for any Owned Modules you acquired without purchase, such as through special events.
ui_RefundConsumablesCB_Info: This is the total refund in C-Bills you are receiving for all of the Owned C-Bill Consumables present in your Inventory at the time of the May 16th patch. Due to changes we've made to Consumables in the new Skill Tree any Consumables in your Inventory have been removed.\nThis is a 1:1 refund of the original C-Bill purchase value for all your Owned C-Bill Consumables! If applicable you'll also receive purchase value C-Bill 'refunds' for any Owned C-Bill Consumables you acquired without purchase, such as through special events.
ui_RefundConsumablesMC_Info: This is the total refund in MC you are receiving for all of the Owned MC Consumables present in your Inventory at the time of the May 16th patch. Due to changes we've made to Consumables in the new Skill Tree any Consumables in your Inventory have been removed.\nThis is a 1:1 refund of the original MC purchase value for all your Owned MC Consumables! If applicable you'll also receive purchase value MC 'refunds' for any Owned MC Consumables you acquired without purchase, such as through special events.
ui_RefundModules_Info: This is the total refund in General Skill Points (GSP) you are receiving for all of the Owned (Non-Consumable) Modules in your Inventory at the time of the May 16th patch (if they were acquired prior to December 3rd 2016). Modules acquired after that date are being refunded to you in full in the form of C-Bills.\nThe amount of GSP you receive for your Owned Modules is determined by the Total Purchase Value of all your Owned Modules divided by 45,000. For example, a total Purchase Value for all your Owned Modules of 50,000,000 C-Bills would result in you receiving 1,111 General Skill Points.\nGeneral Skill Points can be consumed to unlock Skill Nodes for any 'Mech you wish.
ui_RefundPilotTree_Info: This is the total refund in GXP you are receiving for all Pilot Nodes you unlocked with GXP under the previous Skill system.\nThis is a 1:1 refund of all your invested GXP!
ui_MasteryBreakdown_Info:
This is the transfer of Skill Progress from all of your 'Mechs under the previous Skill system. The 'Overall Progress' column in your Refund Ledger refers to the total number of Skills you had unlocked for a listed 'Mech.
Put simply, the Skill status of a 'Mech under the previous system is converted into an associated number of Historic Skill Points (HSP). You can then assign any amount of HSP to a specific variant or its duplicates for use in the Skill Tree.
Each Skill from the previous system is converted into a specific HSP value. For example, Cool Run (Basic) equates to 1 HSP, while Fast Fire (Elite) equates to 10 HSP.
The HSP value is determined according to the XP investment required to unlock the Skill under the previous system. Full Basic status equates to 23 HSP. Full Elite status equates to an additional 34 HSP. Full Master status equates to an additional 34 HSP.
ui_ConfirmSkillPointMigration_GspOnly: Are you sure you want to migrate General Skill Points to 'Mech Skill Points?
ui_ConfirmSkillPointMigration_HspOnly: Are you sure you want to migrate Historic Skill Points to 'Mech Skill Points?
ui_MasteryBreakdown_Info2: A fully Mastered 'Mech therefore receives a base amount of 91 HSP in return. Those 91 points can then be used to acquire full 'Master' status under the new Skill system without needing to spend any C-Bills or XP to unlock the Skill Nodes.\nAdditionally, the amount of HSP received from the Skill status of a 'Mech under the previous Skill system is multiplied by the number of duplicate variants you own of that 'Mech.\nFor example: A player owns three GRF-2N 'Mechs, and had achieved full Elite status for the GRF-2N chassis under the previous Skill system. As part of their transition and refund process they would thus receive a total of 171 HSP for use with their GRF-2N 'Mechs (57 HSP * 3 variants).

ui_RegionDesc:
This setting determines which of the three Server Regions your Team prefers to play on. When matched against a Team with a different Server of preference, the Server used for the match will be automatically chosen based on the Team with the fewest number matches played on their preferred server.

For example: A European team is matched against a North American team. The European Team has run fewer Competitive Matches on their preferred European server than the opposing Team has on their preferred North American server. As a result, the European server will be chosen for that match.

Your preferred Server Region can be changed at any time up until September 19th 2022 at 4:59 PM UTC. On the aforementioned date all Team Roster and Region states will be locked in and will not be eligible for any further changes, so make sure your Roster and Region are finalized and set correctly prior to that date.

ui_CompPlay_Info:
Welcome to the Competitive Play feature!

Competitive Play is an Elo-ranked competitive mode pitting organized Teams against each other in fierce 8v8 engagements.

To join or form a Competitive Team you must have earned the Cadet Bonus 25 Achievement (complete 25 public matches).

The Competitive Play feature is intended for players and Teams operating at the highest levels of skill and organization. Join the fight if you're up for the challenge, but participation should not be taken lightly!

steelviper_long_history:
Steel Viper hold a deep conviction that they alone understand Nicholas Kerensky's original vision, and view as destiny their eventual ascension to the status of ilClan. They are staunch believers in the reformation of the Star League through cooperation, not destruction. Though traditionally a Warden Clan, their military forces are known to undergo one of the most rigorous and demanding training regimens in all the Clan Toumans.

While they did not earn a place in the initial stages of the Clan Invasion, the forces of Steel Viper were later bound by Clan Wolf Khan Ulric Kerensky to share an invasion corridor with Clan Jade Falcon - their bitter rivals - in an ultimately futile attempt by Ulric to stall the Falcon invasion efforts.

Their capacity for negotiation, coupled with their own perceived destiny, instills Steel Viper with the potential for claiming a dominant presence in the unpredictable future of the Inner Sphere.

novacat_long_history:
Nova Cat society is one heavily informed by a tradition of mysticism. They are unique among the Clans in their use of an Oathmaster; keepers of the sacred prophecies of the Nova Cat mystic tradition, responsible for ensuring the spiritual well-being of the Clan. The military forces of Clan Nova Cat are known for placing great priority on the value of accuracy and marksmanship.

While they did not earn a place in the initial stages of the Clan Invasion, Nova Cat were later activated to share an invasion corridor into Draconis Combine territory with Clan Smoke Jaguar, their traditional rivals. The relative successes of Nova Cat’s initial participation through the Invasion were tempered by the dire visions of Oathmaster Biccon Winters, who foretold the defeat of the Clans and doom for Nova Cat itself.

Nova Cat forge their unique path through dusky visions, toward a future guided by prophecy and sacred tradition. They will follow it wherever it leads.

diamondshark_long_history:
Diamond Shark maintain a distinctly liberal society compared to more stringent traditions seen in other Clans. On the battlefield, Diamond Shark leadership empower their commanders to adapt and operate as they deem necessary, unimpeded by limitations of more austere chains of command. Their unique philosophies exist off the battlefield in the form of a powerful Merchant class, the result of a drastically less-restrictive caste system.

These approaches to firmly-entrenched Clan ideals are a constant point of conflict with other Clans, but their invention and monopoly of HarJel – an invaluable resource and system for protecting Clan WarShips and Elementals – has helped them secure an almost unassailable position in Clan power structure.

Though their approach to the invasion differs greatly from the ferocious methods of Jade Falcon or Smoke Jaguar, Diamond Shark strongly believe in the moral necessity of toppling the Great Houses and rending back control of the Inner Sphere.

ui_Page0Title: ARENA BASED COMBAT FOR REWARDS & FAME
ui_Page0Text: A competitive 1v1 and 2v2 arena expansion for MWO.
ui_Page0Body: Solaris is an Elo-ranked competitive mode pitting MechWarriors against each other in fierce 1v1 and 2v2 combat that takes place within exclusive Solaris-only arenas. Any player can participate in Solaris. Choose your division, sign with a Patron, and compete in the Solaris Games for accolades, sponsors and unique rewards. Become the ultimate Solaris champion this season!
ui_Page1Title: WHEN IT COMES TO PERFORMANCE, NOT ALL MECHS ARE CREATED EQUAL
ui_Page1Text: Fight on more equal footing using 'Mechs in the same division.
ui_Page1Body: Every season starts with the Solaris oversight committee dividing every known ‘Mech variant into seven divisions.  Each division is based on a number of properties ranging from loadouts and profiles to flat out battlefield viability.  Every MechWarrior has the choice to participate in whichever division they want to as each division has its own leaderboard.
ui_Page2Title: GO IT ALONE – OR WITH A FRIEND
ui_Page2Text: Fight in 1v1 and 2v2 ranked matches with separate stat tracking.
ui_Page2Body: MechWarriors have the ability to fight solo or group with another MechWarrior to fight in a 2v2 scenario.  MechWarrior stats are tracked separately by solo and group matches.  Match making is done based on the highest MechWarrior’s ranking in group matches and special calculations are performed on the lower ranking MechWarriors.
ui_Page3Title: THE BEST OF THE BEST, YOURSELF…AND ALL THE REST
ui_Page3Text: Divisional leaderboards split between 1v1 and 2v2 ranked matches.
ui_Page3Body: Each division has their own leaderboard.  The leaderboards are broken down into single and dual combatants.  MechWarriors can team up with an ally and compete in 2v2 ranked matches as well.  At the end of a Season, the leaderboards are reset.
ui_Page4Text: End-of-season recognition and rewards for top performers.
ui_Page4Body: A Solaris Games Season lasts for 3 months.  At the end of a season, the best performing MechWarriors are rewarded and all stats are backed up in the Solaris archives.
ui_Page5Title: PERFORMANCE DRIVEN REWARDS COURTESY OF YOUR PATRON
ui_Page5Text: Get paid and move your career forward through your Patron.
ui_Page5Body: ’BattleMech combat is serious business.  Along with the serious combat experience comes serious expenses.  This is where Patrons come into play.  Patrons take on contracts with all MechWarriors participating in the Solaris Games.  Different Patrons provide different payment structures which grow over the course of a season.
ui_Page6Title: EVEN MORE REWARDS FOR YOU, PROVIDING YOU PERFORM
ui_Page6Text: Perform well to attract Sponsors and earn extra income.
ui_Page6Body: Patrons aren’t the only ones providing a source of income during the games.  MechWarriors also have the ability to gain Sponsors throughout their seasonal run.  Unlike contracted Patrons, Sponsors can be gained and lost and their loyalty completely depends on a MechWarrior’s skill on the battlefield.
ui_Page7Text: Obtain Bolt-ons and Supply Caches full of rewards.
ui_Page7Body: One unusual aspect of a Solaris tuned BattleMech is its outward appearance. Solaris is home to ‘Mechs that have unique bolt-on cosmetic equipment. Patrons are the primary means of gaining these bolt-on cosmetics, which are awarded to MechWarriors each time they rank up in a Division. These bolt-ons are awarded either directly or through Supply Caches that also contain a variety of other rewards.

ui_PageFP0Body: Faction Play is a highly-competitive game mode where players fight for control over the territory of the Inner Sphere. Forge a Contract with one of seven invading Clans or one of six Inner Sphere Houses to fight under their banner and earn Faction rewards. Faction Play has a strong emphasis on team cohesion and specialized 'Mech loadouts, and unlike Quick Play there is no skill-based matchmaking system in place! Faction Play matches are often comprised of experienced and organized MechWarriors running well-stocked and heavily customized 'Mech loadouts. If you are new to MechWarrior Online we strongly recommend honing your skills in Quick Play and building up a stock of at least four customized and familiar 'Mechs before joining the fight for the Inner Sphere.

ui_PageFP1Body: A Freelancer is a solo MechWarrior who partakes in Clan vs Inner Sphere conflict in a non-partisan role.  A mercenary for hire with no regard to the politics of war.  Gaining experience and notoriety is the sole movitation behind a Freelancer.\n\nFreelancers earn a 5% XP bonus for every fight they're involved with in regard to Faction Play matches.
ui_PageFP2Body: Mercenary Units are structured Freelancers who choose to fight with brothers and sisters on the battlefield.  Larger financial rewards are paid to these mercenaries who fight for whoever provides them with the all mighty C-Bill and like Freelancers, are politically neutral.  While some say the Factions despise dealing with mercenaries, the progress and battle experience that comes with a Mercenary Unit's involvement in a conflict has led to the progress seen on the Inner Sphere stellar map.\n\nMercenary Units gain notoriety and rewards through Reputation Points (RP) for every match they play in Faction Play.
ui_PageFP3Body:
MechWarriors who dedicate their existence to a singular Faction and will fight to the death in the name of that Faction are some of the most feared combatants on the battlefield. Not only do they bring experience and training to the fray, they bring added an lust for victory at all costs which can strike panic in their enemies.
Loyalists earn Loyalty Points (LP) by participating in Faction Play conflicts on behalf of the Faction they pledged loyalty to.

- When a Loyalist's Faction is directly involved in the conflict at hand, the Loyalist earns LP at 120% of normal LP gain rates.
- When a Loyalist fights for an ally of their Faction, the Loyalist earns LP at 100% of normal LP gain rates.
- When a Loyalist fights for the Inner Sphere or Clans respective to their Faction, the Loyalist earns LP at 100% of normal LP gain rates.
- When a Loyalist fights and their Faction, and all of its allies, are not involved in the conflict, the Loyalist earns LP at 80% of normal LP gain rates.
